Don't quite meet every single requirement, but still believe you'd be a great fit for the job? We'll never know unless you hit the 'Apply' button. Start your journey with us today.

Title: Head of Sales
Description:
**About Us**

Martin is a leading, tech-enabled insurance advisory firm celebrating over 30 years of excellence. We partner with national, regional, and local insurance carriers and Managing General Agents (MGAs) across the U.S. to solve their most critical challenges. Our expertise spans Product Development, Actuarial Services, Regulatory Compliance, State Filings, and Data Analytics. Our mission is simple: build lasting partnerships and deliver technology-driven outcomes that fuel business success.

We recently acquired Adaptify, bringing its engineering team in-house and accelerating our platform roadmap. We are now a fully remote team backed by private equity, with consulting expertise and technology under one roof.

**The Opportunity**

We are hiring a Head of Sales to lead our sales team day to day and build the sales engine for Martin’s next stage of growth. In this newly created role, you will own team performance, pipeline, forecasting, and sales process. That frees our Chief Revenue Officer to focus on revenue strategy, strategic relationships and new markets.

With our recent acquisition of Adaptify, we have a bigger story to tell and a broader offering to sell. This role will shape how we take that combined offering to market.

Selling at Martin is consultative. Our clients increasingly buy expertise and software together, and our deals range from productized platform sales to complex, custom engagements. You will lead a team that sells both well, working alongside Sales Engineers and our Professional Services Group so that what we sell is what we deliver.

This is a builder's role. We are looking for a leader who coaches as well as they close, who brings structure without slowing the team down, and who is energized by taking a capable sales team to the next level.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Lead and develop the sales team**

* Manage, coach and develop the sales team through regular one-on-ones, deal coaching and call reviews
* Set clear expectations for activity, pipeline and results, and hold the team accountable to them
* Hire, onboard and ramp new sellers as the team grows
* Build the team's fluency in selling services and software together

**Own pipeline, forecast and results**

* Own team quota attainment across new business and expansion
* Run a disciplined pipeline and forecast cadence, and report results to the CRO and executive team
* Stay close to the deals that matter: join key client conversations, shape strategy and help the team close
* Use CRM data to spot what is working, what is stalling and where to focus

**Build the sales engine**

* Define and document a repeatable sales process, from qualification through close, for both productized and custom deals
* Establish the playbooks, messaging and tools the team needs to sell consistently
* Partner with the CRO on territory and account planning, pricing approach and compensation design
* Work with Marketing on pipeline generation and with Product on market feedback
* Lead the team's shift to selling the combined services and technology offering, including positioning, messaging and cross-sell into existing clients

**Partner across the business**

* Work with Sales Engineers on discovery, demonstrations and solution design
* Bring the Professional Services Group into deals early so scope, pricing and timelines are right before signature
* Represent Sales in deal review alongside Operations, Finance and Product
* Stay engaged through the transition from sale to delivery, so clients experience one team
* Coordinate with Account Management on renewals and growth within existing clients

**Qualifications**

* 8+ years of B2B sales experience, including 3+ years leading and developing a sales team
* A record of meeting or beating team targets in a consultative, multi-stakeholder sale
* Experience selling professional services, software, or ideally both together
* Insurance, insurtech or financial services experience strongly preferred; curiosity and the ability to learn a technical domain quickly are required
* Experience building sales process and forecasting discipline in a growth-stage company, ideally PE- or VC-backed
* A coaching mindset, with examples of sellers you have developed and promoted
* Comfort working in the details: CRM data, deal strategy and live client conversations
* The ability to build trust across Sales, Delivery, Product and Finance in a fully remote company

**Why Join Us?**

* **Real scope at the right moment.** You will shape how Martin sells as we scale, with direct access to the CRO and executive team.
* **Expertise that scales.** Our value comes from deep insurance expertise, delivered through people and a platform. You will sell something clients need and that few firms can offer.
* **Own the outcomes.** We give leaders room to build and expect them to deliver. You will have the mandate to make the changes the team needs.
* **Do the right thing.** We sell what we can deliver and stand behind it. Long-term client trust matters more to us than a quick close.

* **A remote team that stays connected.** We are fully remote by design and invest in bringing people together.
* **Momentum you can sell.** A recent acquisition, an expanded engineering team and private equity backing give us the product, the resources and the ambition to grow.

**Salary and Benefits**

* **Base salary:** $185,000 – $210,000, based on experience.

* **Variable compensation:** On-target earnings (OTE) of $290,000 – $330,000, with an approximately 65/35 base-to-variable mix. Variable pay is tied to team performance.
* **Benefits:** Our salaries are complemented by an extensive benefits package designed to support your well-being and work-life balance, including:

* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) retirement plan options
* Generous, flexible paid time off (PTO) policy
* Fully remote work environment

* Recruit, develop, and inspire a high-performing team of sellers focused on prospecting, closing, and growing business with advertisers ; establish an agile, high-accountability sales culture tailored to the mid-market segment.
* Own and deliver on quarterly and annual revenue targets, managing pipeline health, forecasting accuracy, rep productivity and ramp time, advertiser retention, and sustainable growth across direct and programmatic channels.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* 15+ years of experience in digital media
* 10+ years of experience in sales or marketing within Mid-Market segment
* 6+ years of experience as a manager
* Experience building integrated and brand advertising campaigns

Description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon's Transportation Excellence (TREX) team in AMET (Middle East, Turkey and Africa) is looking for a Program Manager to drive cost and productivity improvements across our Last Mile delivery network. The team is the single owner of labor cost optimization and productivity across the region. We work with Operations, Finance, Delivery Service Partners (DSPs) and Science teams to deliver great service at the lowest cost per shipment.  
  
You'll be based in Dubai and own a portfolio of cost and productivity programs in one or more AMET countries (UAE, KSA, Egypt and Türkiye). You'll find inefficiencies in route productivity, fleet utilization against paid hours, DSP capacity and channel mix. You'll measure the opportunity and lead launches from pilot to regional scale. You'll build and own weekly and monthly reporting and run deep dives on cost per shipment (CPS) and productivity drivers. You'll also present results in business reviews and help shape annual operating plans (OP1/OP2) with clear, data-backed targets.  
  
This role suits a builder who is comfortable with ambiguity and can move between detailed data analysis and leading teams that don't report to them. You'll be encouraged to use automation and AI tools to scale how we plan and optimize, and to raise the bar on how the network runs. Your work will directly affect the cost structure and customer experience of one of Amazon's fastest-growing regions.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
  

* Own and deliver cost and productivity programs end to end: find the opportunity, build the business case, pilot, launch and sustain
* Track and report key metrics and explain what's driving changes
* Work with Operations, Finance, DSPs, Tech and Science teams to launch process and tool improvements
* Help set annual planning targets and track progress against plan
* Write clear narratives and status updates for senior leadership

  
About the team  
Transportation Excellence (TREX) is the central team that improves how Amazon's Last Mile network runs across the Middle East, Turkey and Africa (AMET). We work closely with the operations teams in the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Egypt and Türkiye. We own the programs that cut cost, raise productivity and improve the delivery experience across the region.  
  
Inside TREX, the Cost & Productivity team is the single owner of Last Mile labor cost and productivity for AMET. We look at the whole picture: route planning, fleet use, partner capacity and how the network is set up. We find where money is being lost and fix it in ways that last and work at scale. We work with Operations, Finance, Delivery Service Partners, Science and Tech teams. We also work side by side with the other TREX teams, such as Customer Experience & Escalations and Line Haul, so that savings never come at the cost of the customer.  
  
We're a small, senior team based in Dubai. We're hands-on, we rely on data, and we're always building. Everyone on the team owns their programs end to end, from the first analysis to launch across the region. You'll get exposure to senior leaders through our weekly and monthly business reviews. We're also early users of automation and AI tools in how we plan, report and make decisions. If you like hard problems, fast-growing markets and seeing your work directly change the business, you'll fit in well here.

Title: Technical Architect – SAP S/4HANA, ABAP & BTP
Description:

**Location**: Remote

**Employment Type**: Full-Time

**Department**: Professional Services / Delivery

**Reports To**: Practice Director / VP Delivery

### **About the Role**

Bramasol is seeking an experienced SAP Technical Architect with strong expertise in SAP S/4HANA, ABAP, and SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) to help customers translate complex business challenges into practical, scalable, and sustainable SAP solutions.

The ideal candidate combines deep technical knowledge with business understanding, curiosity, sound judgment, and strong consulting skills. This individual understands not only how SAP technologies work, but when and why to apply them to achieve the best business outcomes.

This is a hands-on, client-facing technical leadership role focused on bridging business and technology. The Technical Architect will evaluate requirements, explore alternative approaches, and recommend appropriate solutions leveraging standard SAP functionality, ABAP development, SAP BTP services, integrations, extensions, automation, and emerging technologies.

We are looking for a natural problem solver who asks thoughtful questions, challenges assumptions constructively, and approaches complex challenges with a “let’s figure out how” mindset, rather than simply explaining why something cannot be done.

### **Key Responsibilities**

### **Business Understanding & Technical Problem Solving**

* Engage with business stakeholders and functional teams to understand business objectives, challenges, and underlying requirements.
* Ask thoughtful questions, challenge assumptions, and explore alternative approaches to solving business problems.
* Translate business requirements into practical SAP technical solution options, clearly communicating trade-offs, risks, costs, and long-term implications.
* Evaluate when to leverage standard SAP functionality, ABAP, SAP BTP, integrations, extensions, automation, or other technologies.
* Recommend solutions that balance business value, technical feasibility, implementation effort, and long-term maintainability.

### **Technical Architecture & Solution Design**

* Design scalable, secure, and supportable technical solutions across SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition, Public Edition, and hybrid landscapes.
* Apply SAP Clean Core principles when evaluating standard capabilities, ABAP Cloud, in-app and side-by-side extensibility, APIs, and integration approaches.
* Provide architectural guidance across SAP BTP services, including Integration Suite, API Management, and relevant development and automation capabilities.
* Evaluate technical dependencies, data flows, integration patterns, security considerations, performance requirements, and operational supportability.
* Lead technical discovery sessions, solution design workshops, and architecture reviews.
* Establish and promote technical standards, reusable patterns, and development best practices.

### **Technical Leadership & Delivery Accountability**

* Provide technical leadership across SAP implementations, migrations, integrations, enhancements, and transformation initiatives.
* Take ownership of technical architecture decisions and remain engaged throughout development, testing, deployment, and stabilization to ensure successful outcomes.
* Guide and mentor ABAP developers, integration specialists, BTP consultants, and other technical team members.
* Review technical designs, challenge proposed approaches, and assist in resolving complex technical issues.
* Collaborate with project managers, functional leads, and other architects to identify risks, manage dependencies, and drive decisions to closure.
* Proactively communicate technical concerns, recommend solutions, and follow through on commitments.

### **Customer Consulting & Collaboration**

* Build trusted customer relationships through technical credibility, clear communication, responsiveness, and a commitment to customer success.
* Translate complex technical concepts into understandable business language to support informed decision-making.
* Work collaboratively across functional and technical disciplines to develop solutions that address customer needs.
* Demonstrate ownership, professional judgment, and accountability when navigating challenging customer situations.
* Maintain a solutions-oriented approach, exploring possibilities and practical alternatives when faced with technical or business constraints.

### **Innovation & Business Development**

* Stay current with SAP S/4HANA, BTP, ABAP Cloud, RAP, Fiori, Integration Suite, and emerging SAP technologies.
* Identify opportunities to leverage automation, AI-enabled tools, and modern SAP capabilities to improve customer outcomes.
* Contribute to Bramasol’s technical knowledge, reusable solutions, accelerators, and delivery practices.
* Support pre-sales activities, including technical discovery, architecture discussions, solution estimates, and proposal development.

### **Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Extensive experience in SAP technical consulting, solution architecture, or technical leadership within complex enterprise environments.
* Strong foundation in SAP ABAP development, including object-oriented ABAP, enhancements, interfaces, APIs, and modern development approaches.
* Solid understanding of SAP S/4HANA architecture, extensibility, integration technologies, and technical design principles.
* Practical experience with SAP BTP and modern SAP integration approaches, particularly Integration Suite.
* Familiarity with SAP Clean Core principles, ABAP Cloud, RAP, CDS, OData, and SAP Fiori development approaches.
* Demonstrated experience defining technical solutions and guiding development teams through implementation.
* Ability to evaluate competing technical approaches and recommend solutions based on business value, architectural suitability, and long-term supportability.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Demonstrated accountability for technical decisions, delivery commitments, and successful customer outcomes.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Architecture experience across multiple full-lifecycle SAP S/4HANA implementations or transformation initiatives.
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition and/or Public Edition.
* Working knowledge of SAP Finance (FI/CO), Sales and Distribution (SD), or other enterprise business processes.
* Experience with event-driven architecture, API Management, SAP BTP extension services, and automation.
* Experience supporting technical pre-sales, solution estimation, and customer advisory engagements.
* SAP certifications in relevant S/4HANA, ABAP, BTP, or Integration Suite technologies.

### **What We’re Looking For**

* **Ownership and accountability**: A willingness to take responsibility, identify risks early, and follow through until issues are resolved.

Title: FACILITIES MAINTENANCE & CONTRACTOR SAFETY OFFICER
Description:
**Job Summery**

  

The Facilities Maintenance & Contractor Safety Officer is responsible for ensuring the safe, efficient, and compliant operation of facility maintenance activities while managing contractor safety performance across the organization. The role focuses on maintaining a safe work environment, ensuring compliance with applicable health, safety, environmental, and regulatory requirements, and supporting the effective delivery of maintenance and facility management services.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

**Facilities Maintenance Management**

* Coordinate facility inspections, audits, and preventive maintenance activities.
* Ensure compliance with local building regulations, safety standards, and organizational requirements.
* Support the implementation of energy efficiency and sustainability initiatives within facility operations.
* Monitor facility conditions and recommend corrective or improvement actions.
  

**Contractor Safety Management**

* Develop, implement, and enforce contractor safety policies and procedures.
* Conduct contractor pre-qualification assessments to evaluate safety performance, certifications, and compliance records.
* Review and approve Permit-to-Work (PTW) documentation, risk assessments, and method statements before work commences.
* Ensure hazards are identified and appropriate control measures are implemented.
* Conduct contractor inductions, safety briefings, and toolbox talks.
* Monitor contractor activities to ensure compliance with safety standards and PPE requirements.
* Maintain accurate PTW records and suspend permits when safety conditions are not met.
  

**Safety Inspections & Compliance**

* Conduct regular workplace safety inspections and facility audits.
* Identify safety hazards and ensure corrective actions are implemented.
* Investigate incidents, accidents, and near misses to determine root causes and preventive measures.
* Ensure compliance with fire safety requirements, emergency procedures, and hazardous material management.
* Maintain Safety Data Sheets (SDS) and related safety documentation.
* Liaise with regulatory authorities and external auditors during inspections and compliance reviews.
  

**Emergency Preparedness & Response**

* Ensure fire protection systems, emergency exits, alarms, and first-aid facilities are properly maintained.
* Develop and coordinate emergency response and evacuation plans.
* Organize and monitor fire drills and emergency exercises.
* Act as a key liaison between facility management, emergency responders, and regulatory authorities during emergencies.
  

**Audits and Inspections**

* Conduct routine HSE inspections, fire risk assessments, and compliance audits.
* Utilize inspection checklists and assessment tools to evaluate workplace safety.
* Document findings and communicate corrective actions to relevant stakeholders.
* Support external audits and regulatory inspections.
  

**Documentation & Reporting**

* Maintain records related to maintenance activities, inspections, permits, audits, incidents, and risk assessments.
* Prepare periodic HSE and facility performance reports.
* Track contractor compliance metrics and monitor adherence to contractual HSE obligations.
* Maintain accurate records in accordance with company and regulatory requirements.
  

**Daily Operational Support**

* Support the Research Safety Manager in implementing HSE and facilities management strategies.
* Monitor compliance with HSE policies, procedures, and standards across operations.
* Ensure subcontractors and service providers comply with organizational HSE requirements.
* Perform additional duties and responsibilities as assigned.
  

**Operating Environment**

* Work is performed in both office and field environments.
* Travel to various facilities and regulatory agencies may be required.
* Availability to respond to emergencies outside normal working hours is essential.
* Exposure to varying environmental conditions, hazardous materials, chemicals, animals, toxic plants, and specialized equipment may occur.
* Use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) is required when necessary.
* Physical activities may include standing, walking, climbing, bending, and lifting.
* Ability to work in confined spaces, at heights, and in challenging environmental conditions.
  

**Communication & Working Relationships**

  

**Research Safety Manager**

* Provide regular updates on compliance performance, risk assessments, incidents, and corrective actions.
* Report daily operational activities and seek guidance when required.
* Present audit findings and improvement recommendations.
  

**HSE Team**

* Collaborate on risk assessments, audits, inspections, and training activities.
* Share best practices and regulatory updates.
* Support emergency response planning and drills.
  

**Facilities Management Personnel & Contractors**

* Coordinate maintenance activities and safety requirements.
* Ensure safe execution of work and compliance with operational procedures.
* Address facility-related hazards and environmental concerns.
  

**Regulatory Authorities & External Stakeholders**

* Submit compliance reports and required documentation.
* Facilitate inspections conducted by regulatory bodies.
* Implement recommendations arising from external audits and reviews.
* Participate in professional forums and industry networks to maintain awareness of best practices.
  

**Qualifications, Knowledge, Skills & Experience**

  

**Education**

* Bachelor's Degree in Facilities Management, Occupational Health & Safety, Engineering, Environmental Science, or a related discipline.
  

**Professional Certifications (Preferred)**

* NEBOSH International General Certificate (IGC)
* Certified Safety Professional (CSP)
* Certified Facilities Manager (CFM)
* Certified Industrial Hygienist (CIH)
* Construction Health & Safety Technician (CHST)
* Project Management Professional (PMP)
  

**Experience**

* Minimum 3 years of experience in Facilities Management, Occupational Health & Safety, or Environmental Health & Safety.
* Experience conducting risk assessments, incident investigations, compliance audits, and safety inspections.
* Experience managing contractors and Permit-to-Work systems.
  

**Knowledge & Skills**

* Strong knowledge of HSE regulations, facility management principles, and safety management systems.
* Understanding of environmental and occupational safety standards, including OSHA, NFPA, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, and relevant Qatar regulations.
* Knowledge of emergency preparedness and incident management.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and training skills.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational abilities.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams.
* Proficiency in MS Office, Power BI, and HSE management software.
* Familiarity with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001 management systems.

Title: Legal Counsel
Description:
Echelon contracts continuously: a portfolio of technology partners on structural, programme and referral agreements, MOUs and term sheets with defence and energy technology companies, customer Scopes of Work delivered by our forward deployed teams, and a share plan that reaches every employee.

We are looking for a qualified hands-on lawyer — admitted to practice, with the training that comes with it — who has drafted and negotiated the contracts behind technology and AI delivery services, understands how those businesses work, and has the head for it: one who would rather be the only counsel in the room than one of twenty. The legal function grows next year; you will have shaped how it works before it does.

**THE ROLE: WHAT YOU WILL OWN**
-------------------------------

You will run the day-to-day legal work of the group: drafting, negotiating and closing under the group’s standards, keeping the corporate house in order, and working with the General Counsel and external counsel on the matters that need them. The growing part of that work is services contracting: Echelon sells the expertise and time of its engineers, and the master services agreements, Scopes of Work, rate cards, staffing and subcontracting agreements under which they are deployed are heavily negotiated contracts the group signs. You will draft them, negotiate them and close them. Under the Delegation of Authority the CEO is the only signatory, so the quality of what reaches his desk is the whole of the job. Partnerships with technology companies require a different discipline: referral, revenue-share and reseller agreements, IP boundaries and exclusivity terms that must protect Echelon’s margin and position over the life of the relationship, not only the length of one engagement.

You will carry files from first draft to signature, hold Echelon’s positions on exclusivity, margin protection and first right of refusal for our forward deployed teams, and decide what needs the General Counsel and what does not. The method exists; you own the outcome inside it and decide the sequencing and the trade-offs, so that most files close on standard paper and the exceptions get the attention they deserve.

* **Services contracting:** Master services agreements, Scopes of Work, rate cards, and staffing and subcontracting agreements for our engineering services business — with customers, with the partners we deploy for and with the firms we deploy alongside. Large, recurring contracts, often negotiated on the other side’s paper: you draft, negotiate and close them.
* **Partner & commercial contracting:** NDAs, MOUs, term sheets, referral and revenue-share agreements, from first draft to signature through the DoA signature process.
* **Templates & playbooks:** The recurring instruments — partner referral agreement, Partner Revenue Share terms, Scope of Work, NDA, employment contract and amendment — so that most files close on standard paper.
* **Corporate housekeeping:** Board and shareholder resolutions, registers, the shareholders’ agreement and the share plan documentation for the holding company and the Saudi operating company, with the GNRC.
* **Employment & regulatory:** Contracts, performance-bonus amendments, policies and Saudi labour-law compliance with the People function; the regulatory perimeter around data, licensing and, with Echelon Defense Industries, clearance-bound activity.
* **Intellectual property:** Engineering IP held at group level, partner IP boundaries in every deployment, and the protection of Echelon-developed capability as it is productised.

**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR - WHERE WE ALIGN**
-------------------------------------------

A hands-on lawyer who reads fast, drafts clean and marks uncertainty rather than inventing a position. You find contracts interesting because of what they make possible, not because of what they prevent.

* **Curiosity:** You want to understand the deal before you paper it: where the value sits, what the partner actually wants, what the technology does. You hold the position that protects it.
* **Speed of learning:** An unfamiliar instrument — a share plan, a referral agreement, a defence MOU — comes back from you as a workable draft, not as a list of questions.
* **Ownership & pace:** A file is yours from first draft to signature. You turn a term sheet in days and keep the corporate record current without being asked.
* **Judgement:** Pragmatic on commercial points, immovable on the ones that matter. You escalate the right things and explain why in three sentences.
* **Where you are:** A qualified lawyer — a law degree and admission to practice are required — based in Saudi Arabia or the UAE, with hands-on experience of delivery-services contracting — Scopes of Work, master services and subcontracting agreements — and a working understanding of the technology and AI sector; fluent legal drafting in English, with Arabic spoken and written. What you have closed counts for more than how many years you have been closing.

**OUR VALUES**
--------------

* **Customer first:** You measure your work by customer outcomes, and prioritise accordingly.
* **Ownership mentality :**You own outcomes end to end. When something breaks or stalls, you treat it as yours to fix.
* **Clear communicator:** You explain complex systems simply, to operators and executives alike, and make the value of your work visible.
* **Comfortable with ambiguity:** You make progress with incomplete information, partial data and unfamiliar environments, and you enjoy solving problems where there is no structure yet.
* **Long-term builder:** You invest in Echelon’s long-term success, bringing field insight back into our strategy and operations.

**Languages:** English & Arabic fluent  
**Reporting:** Echelon CEO; dotted line to Echelon’s holding Legal Counsel department  
**Package:** A base salary with housing and education allowances, medical cover, and equity through the employee equity programme. Terms are shared at offer stage.

---------------

Title: Senior Cybersecurity Specialist - Saudi National
Description:
**Job Description**

The Cybersecurity Senior Specialist shall be responsible for the leadership, governance, assurance, and oversight of all cybersecurity activities. The role will ensure that cybersecurity requirements are defined, implemented, verified, and maintained throughout the project lifecycle, from design and procurement through testing, commissioning, handover and operations readiness.

The Cybersecurity Manager will provide strategic direction and management oversight across Information Technology (IT), Operational Technology (OT), railway control systems, communications systems, station systems and connected infrastructure to ensure cyber risks are identified, managed, and reduced to an acceptable level.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Cybersecurity Leadership**

* Develop and implement the project cybersecurity management strategy and cybersecurity assurance framework.
* Establish cybersecurity governance arrangements across all project stakeholders.
* Lead cybersecurity working groups, technical reviews and management reporting activities.
* Act as the primary cybersecurity focal point for the project.

**Regulatory and Stakeholder Management**

* Interface directly with RCRC regarding cybersecurity requirements, compliance activities and assurance reporting.
* Interface with the National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA) on matters relating to regulatory compliance and cybersecurity controls.
* Coordinate cybersecurity reviews with government agencies, Contractor, Metro Operators and other external stakeholders.
* Support cybersecurity audits, inspections, and regulatory assessments.

**Project Delivery Assurance**

* Ensure cybersecurity requirements are integrated into project requirements, specifications, contracts and supplier deliverables.
* Verify cybersecurity requirements are appropriately addressed throughout system design, implementation, testing and commissioning.
* Review and approve cybersecurity documentation produced by contractors and suppliers.
* Monitor implementation of cybersecurity measures across all project packages and disciplines.

**Risk Management**

* Establish and maintain the project Cybersecurity Risk Register.
* Identify, assess and manage cybersecurity threats and vulnerabilities affecting project systems and assets.
* Ensure cybersecurity risks are addressed through appropriate mitigation measures and assurance evidence.
* Support risk acceptance and management decision-making processes.

**System and Operational Technology Security**

* Provide cybersecurity oversight of the Contractor for railway signalling, telecommunications, control systems, SCADA, networking infrastructure, station systems and operational technology environments.
* Ensure the Contractor provides appropriate segregation, protection and monitoring of critical operational networks.
* Review the Contractor’s cybersecurity architecture and defence-in-depth strategies and propose guidance.
* Support secure integration between operational and enterprise systems.

**Assurance and Compliance**

* Oversee and guide Contractor’s cybersecurity assurance management activities across the project lifecycle.
* Oversee cybersecurity testing, vulnerability assessments, penetration testing and compliance verification activities with the Contractor.
* Ensure the Contractor develops quality cybersecurity case documentation and evidence required for project approvals.
* Support independent assessment and certification activities where required.

**Handover and Operational Readiness**

* Support the development of operational cybersecurity procedures and incident management arrangements.
* Ensure cybersecurity controls are fully implemented prior to system acceptance and handover.
* Coordinate cybersecurity readiness reviews for revenue service commencement.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline.
* Master's Degree in Cybersecurity, Information Security, Engineering Management or a related discipline is highly desirable.
* Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, GICSP, IEC 62443 or equivalent are highly desirable.

**Experience Requirements**

* Minimum 20 years of professional experience in cybersecurity, systems assurance, critical infrastructure, rail, transportation or major infrastructure projects.
* Minimum 10 years in a senior leadership or management role.
* Demonstrable experience delivering cybersecurity programmes on large-scale complex transportation, rail, metro, aviation, defence, utility or other critical infrastructure projects.
* Experience interfacing with government authorities, regulators, and owner organisations.
* Experience managing cybersecurity requirements through design, implementation, testing, and commissioning phases.
* Experience working within multi-contractor and international project environments.
* Previous Middle East or Saudi Arabia project experience is highly desirable.

**Knowledge Requirements**

* Saudi National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA) frameworks, controls, and regulatory requirements.
* Cybersecurity risk management and assurance methodologies.
* Industrial Control Systems (ICS) and Operational Technology (OT) cybersecurity.
* Railway systems including signalling, communications, SCADA, AFC, PSDs and station systems.
* IEC 62443, ISO 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework and related standards.
* Cybersecurity governance, auditing and compliance management.

**Key Competencies**

* Strategic leadership and stakeholder management.
* Strong communication and influencing skills.
* Risk-based decision making.
* Regulatory engagement and compliance management.
* Technical understanding of critical infrastructure cybersecurity.
* Contract and supplier management.
* Report writing and executive-level communication.

**Security Clearance**

The successful candidate must be capable of obtaining and maintaining any project, client or governmental security clearances required for the execution of the role.

Title: Infrastructure Engineer TID
Description:
**Company Description**

Egis is a leading global architectural, consulting, construction engineering, operations and mobility services firm. We create and operate intelligent infrastructure and buildings that both respond to the climate emergency and contribute to balanced, sustainable and resilient development.

Our 23,500 employees operate across over 70 countries, deploying their expertise to develop and deliver cutting-edge innovations and solutions for clients. Through the wide range of our activities, we are central to the collective organisation of society and the living environment of citizens all over the world.

 **Job Description**

**Job Purpose:**

Under general supervision performs responsible professional engineering review, assessment, inspection, and administrative duties. This includes reviews of design- & construction- and development proposals related to all infrastructure projects (i.e., roads, highways, bridges, utilities of all kinds, etc.) and ensuring compliance with Qatar Rail requirements, asset protection and future safeguarding. Further advises interfacing parties on NOC requirements, conditions and required actions to obtain approvals.

**Duties & Responsibilities:**

The **Infrastructure Engineer** will be responsible for the review of 3rd party applications in reference to Metro/ LRT/Long Distance project interfaces for the operational railways and future phases. The tasks will include review of plans, schematics, calculations, and specifications. The Infrastructure Engineer is required to effectively work with all involved parties, assess proposals, make recommendations, and determines comprehensive response to 3rd party requests. It includes working closely with, coordinating, and collaborating with all Qatar Rail departments, agencies/authorities, designers, and contractors internal and external to ensure conclusive and timely response. These responsibilities include attending meetings with various stakeholders.

* Provide infrastructure interface & coordination services (assistance, guidance) for the Qatar Rail schemes in relation to multiple interfaces with applicants, designers, utility agencies, contractors, stakeholders, etc.
* Review, assess, evaluate, and respond to third party requests, design-, engineering-, and construction- documents including plans, work method and specifications to ensure compliance with applicable requirements, codes, ordinances, and standards (NOC, MME, DR, RO, PTW, IPD, others); with sound understanding of utility works.
* Supporting the sr. engineer and manager as well as the relevant co-workers, departments in tasks related to approvals.
* Ensure & check completeness of documents and submissions as part of the NOC process.
* Provide and prepare interface drawings and relevant response documents.
* Participate in and create manuals, forms, procedures for processing stakeholder applications.
* Identify elements for optimizations and improvement of the department.
* Act as a link between PMC, D&B contractor and third parties.
* Attend and record meetings and act as contact person for local authorities.
* As required, inspect sites on a periodical basis to ensure conformance with permits, design specifications and adherence to quality. Provide site inspection reports.
* Resolve issues within level of authority and address modifications or changes.
* Plan, organize, track, control and evaluate the assigned functions and activities. Works proactively and responsibly.
* Maintain logs and records of work performed; prepares periodic and special reports.
* Monitor and track the TID correspondence (documentation of day-to-day work).
* Performs related duties as assigned.

**General:**

* Incorporate zero harm into staff yearly performance reviews by incorporating and taking into consideration, staff commitment to the Qatar Rail values of safety and environment.
* Commitment to the Zero Harm Ethos by leading by example and taking personal responsibility for their own health and safety and proactively ensuring that any health and safety concerns observed are raised to prevent harm.
* Support the QR Environmental program in reducing QR carbon footprint.
* Managers need to be familiar with relevant laws, regulations and standards that apply to their area of operation.
* Proactive identification of potential hazards/environmental aspects and implementing effective control measures to minimize risks.
* Liaise with HSE professionals from QSHESE Department on complex issues.
* Comply with Qatar Rail’s Company Management System requirements which covers Quality, Health, Safety, Environment, Information Security, Business continuity, Security and Emergency preparedness requiements.
* Attendance of any QSHESE Induction, training, briefing, or meeting as and when required and/or requested to.
* Be mindful that Health and Safety, Quality, Security and Environment is everyone’s responsibility and as such all-Qatar Rail employees are accountable for reporting and intervening in Health, Safety, Quality, Security and Environmental violations.
* Report all incidents and/or near misses, and/or unsafe acts or conditions and where appropriate make recommendations for improvement.
* Ensure your visitor (including contractors, PMCs) are aware of Qatar Rail premise’s emergency response plans.
* Act ethically and within Qatar Rail’s Code of Conduct.
* Undertake additional tasks as required based emerging business needs.

**Authorities:**

The position covers all interfaces through Technical Interface Department with the relevant authorities and governmental bodies. The main interface is related to authorities and stakeholders in relation to 3rd party management for the purpose of permitting within the Rail-Protection-Zone.

**Accountabilities:**

* Establishing clear line of communication with the relevant team members, departments, external stakeholders.
* Review and approve NOC-third party applications, for resign review (DR)- and road opening (RO), permit applications.
* Participate & prepare clear procedure(s) related to stakeholder management.
* Produce status- and progress reports.
* Participate in meetings, audits, presentations, workshops, and other events

**Key Interfaces:**

***Internal:***

* All Metro-, Tram lines and Long-Distance Railway.
* Departments within Program Delivery & Service Delivery
* Contractors & Joint Ventures & Consultants.
* RKH Qitarat (Service Provider)

***External:***

* Ministry of Transport, Ministry of Municipality, Public Works Authority, Civil Aviation Authority, Qatar Foundation, Private Engineering Office, Ministry of Interior (multiple departments), Supreme Committee for Delivery & Legacy, Qatar Olympic Committee, Qatar Ports Authority, Qatar Armed Forces, Hamad International Airport .
* Kahramaa Electricity & Water, Qatar Cool, Qatar Energy (Petroleum), Vodafone, QNBN, Ooredoo, MOI Police, other affected utility companies.
* Third party developers (governmental & private)
* Contractors & consultants
* Third party entities potentially affecting the Qatar Rail assets within the Rail Protection Zone.

 **Qualifications**  

* (B.Sc.) degree in civil engineering or related engineering discipline.
* A minimum of 4 years of documentable experience in fields of infrastructure/utility design and preferably large-scale projects and railway projects. GCC experience is beneficial.
* Knowledge of permitting procedures, requirements, and public approvals.
* Knowledge in infrastructure planning, design, and construction of roads, bridges, drinking water, wastewater, storm drainage, irrigation, power transmission/distribution, and preferably gas-, oil pipelines, district cooling.
* Registered as professional engineer is desirable.
* Membership with professional bodies is desirable.

 **Additional Information**

**Skills:**

* Advanced computer skills in Microsoft office including Word, Excel, Power Point and other computer programs.
* Experience with web-based collaboration technologies for project information and process management software (i.e., Aconex, QDRS / QPRO, etc.).
* Experience with AutoCAD is desired.
* Excellent technical writing skills.
* Applicant to be fluent in English (verbal/written); Arabic language skills are beneficial.

**Soft Competencies:**

* Excellent verbal, written communication skills and presentation skills
* Self-motivated team-player, capable of working independently & organized
* Ability to analyze situations accurately and take effective action & make critical decisions in stressful situations
* Communicate effectively with stakeholders, peers, and members of the public.

The Senior Threat Hunter & DFIR Specialist leads complex investigations, proactive threat hunting, and authorized adversary testing across endpoint, identity, network, application, Microsoft 365, Azure, and hybrid-cloud environments.

* Conduct hypothesis-driven threat hunts using Microsoft Defender XDR, Microsoft Sentinel, KQL, and enterprise telemetry to identify malicious activity and emerging threats

* Strong knowledge of enterprise systems, endpoint security, SIEM/EDR, identity, networking, cloud security, and attacker tradecraft, including MITRE ATT&CK

* Experience with forensic and endpoint triage tools such as KAPE or Velociraptor, including the collection and analysis of disk, memory, VM, and cloud evidence

Title: ITSM Consultant
Description:

You will work across key ITSM processes, including change, incident, problem, asset, and request management, helping strengthen service quality, maintain compliance, and improve operational efficiency. * Partner with the Client Experience and Operations teams to improve revenue visibility and reduce manual intervention
* Partner with the Practices and Service Owners to ensure billing and costing models are addressed as part of service realization or service iteration efforts
* Contribute to the ongoing optimization of ITIL-aligned processes including Incident, Change, Request, Problem, Knowledge and Asset Management
* Support documentation quality reviews, process standardization, and reporting improvements across SMO functions
* Identify opportunities for automation, simplification, and improved client-facing workflows within ITSM practices

### **What You Bring:**

* 3+ years' experience in IT Service Management, Business Operations, or Financial Governance in a managed services or IT environment
* Familiarity with managed services contract structures, SLAs
* Solid understanding of ITIL principles with minimum ITIL Practitioner certification
* Experience with service management tools (e.g., ServiceNow)
* Strong analytical skills with attention to detail and comfort working with spreadsheets and operational data
* Demonstrated ability to drive process improvement and cross-functional collaboration
* Excellent communication and problem-solving skills
* **Certified Associate Project Manager**
* Agile Hybrid Project Pro
* Familiarity with billing models
* Experience in revenue assurance, financial operations, or service delivery audits
* Proficiency with Power BI or other reporting tools

* ITIL 4 Foundation
* Project Management Professional (PMP)

**Lead Operational Excellence at Toronto South Detention Centre**  
  
The Ministry of the Solicitor General is seeking an accomplished and forward-thinking leader to serve as **Deputy Superintendent of Operations at Toronto South Detention Centre (TSDC).** As a key member of the institution's executive leadership team, you will work closely with the Superintendent to provide strategic direction and operational oversight for one of Ontario's largest and most complex correctional institutions. This highly visible leadership role is responsible for advancing institutional priorities, fostering a culture of safety and accountability, and ensuring correctional operations are delivered effectively in support of public safety, staff wellbeing, and organizational excellence.
  
  
The **Deputy Superintendent of Operations** provides strategic and operational leadership for institutional security, emergency preparedness, incident management, workforce planning, labour relations, risk management, and operational performance. Leading a team of managers and front-line correctional professionals, you will ensure the safe, secure, and efficient operation of the institution while promoting employee engagement, continuous improvement, and respectful workplace practices. You will play a critical role in managing complex operational challenges, supporting organizational change, and ensuring compliance with legislative requirements, ministry policies, and professional standards, while helping to shape the future direction and success of TSDC.
  
  
**Please note:** Deputy Superintendents are expected to participate in a rotational on-call schedule and may assume overall responsibility for the administration and operation of the institution during after-hours, weekends, and emergency situations.
  
  
**Leadership That Makes a Difference**
  
  
At its core, leadership in the Ontario Public Service (OPS) is about creating positive change for people and communities across Ontario. We're looking for leaders who are authentic, accountable, and courageous. People who bring others together, ask bold questions, and lead with purpose.

**About the job**
-----------------

We believe great leadership starts with high standards and strong support. In the OPS, that means showing up with authenticity, acting with integrity, and having the courage to do what's right, even when it's hard.
  
  
As a leader, you'll shape a team culture that sparks innovation, supports collaboration, and champions inclusion. You'll help build a workplace that is diverse, anti-racist, and accessible, where everyone feels safe, respected, and able to thrive.
  
  
You won't be doing it alone. We invest in our leaders through mentorship, learning opportunities, and cross-ministry networks that help you grow your impact and connect with peers across the organization.
  
  
Leadership is about impact, and in this role, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful one. You will:  
  
  

* **Provide Strategic Leadership** by leading multidisciplinary teams, setting operational direction, and fostering a positive, accountable, and high-performing workplace culture that supports institutional and ministry objectives.
* **Oversee Correctional Operations** by providing strategic leadership for the day-to-day operation of the institution, ensuring the safe custody, supervision, and care of inmates while maintaining effective and efficient service delivery.
* **Manage Operational Resources and Performance** by directing workforce planning, staff deployment, scheduling, and resource allocation to support institutional safety, operational readiness, and organizational objectives.
* **Drive Operational Excellence** by monitoring performance, identifying opportunities for improvement, and implementing strategies, policies, and initiatives that enhance operational effectiveness, accountability, and service quality.
* **Build Collaborative Partnerships** by developing and maintaining productive relationships with institutional leaders, correctional staff, bargaining agents, community partners, and justice-sector stakeholders to support institutional priorities.
* **Lead Through Emergencies and Complex Operational Issues** by providing leadership during critical incidents, emergency situations, operational challenges, and organizational change initiatives while delivering effective solutions in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

  
Your ability to align your team's efforts with broader organizational goals will be key to your success, and to the success of the people we serve.
  
  
**Meet Your New Team**
  
  
**Toronto South Detention Centre (TSDC)** is a dynamic, multi-purpose correctional facility committed to public safety, accountability, and the rehabilitation of individuals in custody. As one of Ontario's largest and most complex correctional institutions, TSDC supports a broad range of operational, security, health care, and rehabilitative services delivered by highly skilled professionals in a fast-paced environment where leadership, collaboration, and sound judgment are essential. The institution plays a critical role in Ontario's correctional system by maintaining a safe and secure environment while supporting evidence-informed programming, staff development, and continuous improvement, making it an impactful and rewarding workplace for leaders who thrive in complex, high-responsibility settings.

**What you bring to the team**
------------------------------

  
  

### **Leadership and People Management**

* Experience providing strategic leadership, direction, coaching, and mentorship to diverse teams in a complex operational environment.
* Ability to foster employee engagement, accountability, inclusion, and a positive workplace culture.
* Proven experience managing labour relations matters, workforce planning, employee performance, and staff development initiatives.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through change, navigate complex operational challenges, and achieve organizational objectives.
  

  

### **Correctional Operations and Strategic Management**

* Experience overseeing complex operational environments, correctional services, security functions, programs, or institutional activities within a large organization.
* Ability to establish priorities, allocate human and physical resources, and make sound decisions in dynamic and fast-paced environments.
* Knowledge of operational planning, performance measurement, emergency preparedness, and continuous improvement principles.
* Proven ability to balance competing priorities while maintaining operational effectiveness, safety, security, and service excellence.
  

  

### **Risk Management and Strategic Decision-Making**

* Experience identifying, assessing, and mitigating operational, organizational, or institutional risks.
* Knowledge of legislation, policies, procedures, and governance frameworks applicable to complex operational environments.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate complex issues, assess risks, and make evidence-based recommendations.
* Experience ensuring compliance with legislative, regulatory, policy, and organizational requirements while promoting accountability and transparency.
  

  

### **Relationship Building and Communication**

* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence, engage, and collaborate with diverse audiences.
* Experience building and maintaining productive relationships with internal and external stakeholders, bargaining agents, community partners, and justice-sector organizations.
* Ability to negotiate, resolve conflicts, and manage sensitive or high-profile issues with professionalism, diplomacy, and sound judgment.
* Experience preparing and delivering briefings, reports, presentations, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership and decision-makers.

Title: Physiotherapist
Description:
Physiotherapists treat patients with physical difficulties resulting from illness, injury, disability or ageing. They treat people of all ages including children, the elderly, stroke patients and people with sports injuries . They work with patients to identify and improve their movement and function. They help promote their patients' health and wellbeing and assist the rehabilitation process by developing and restoring body systems, in particular the neuromuscular, musculoskeletal, cardiovascular and respiratory systems. They devise and review treatment programs, comprising manual therapy, movement, therapeutically exercise and the application of technological equipment, e.g. IDD therapy. Physiotherapists also provide advice on how to prevent injury.

Description:

**Key Accountabilities 1**
--------------------------

* Build a well-established knowledge of charter parties and their commercial implications in any regard that may result in exposure to claims.
* Monitor the performance of the vessels against the charter parties and highlight any areas that may result in any demurrage, performance warranty and off-hire claims, as necessary.

Further, follow up immediately with the vessels’ technical manager to address any underperformance observations or concerns.

* Ensure compliance with proper procedures regarding management and approval of claims with reference to the respective and relevant internal lines of approval.
* Monitor and track the Charterers’ accounts, in collaboration with Finance, from a financial perspective to highlight any areas of concern where transactions would need attention. i.e. Hire, claims, cost reimbursement, etc.
* Facilitate regular meetings with Charterers for business discussions on the topic of claims, as required.

--------------------------

**Legal and Insurance:**

* Review terms of Charter Party with Legal and Insurance functions and ensure that company’s interests are protected by ensuring necessary insurance coverage is in place, proper defense is arranged through vessels’ P&I Club and finally seek reimbursement of relevant expenses from charterers as per charter party clauses.
* Negotiate TCP claims, seek legal advice and provide recommendations to Head of Chartering.

**Planning:**

* Use all possible means for voyage planning including the use of software tools to monitor and coordinate all activities related to voyage. Also, analyze variance between the voyage plans versus the actual plan, while generating report for the Head of Chartering.

* Implement approved policies, processes, and procedures, and provide instructions to subordinates to ensure their proper implementation.

Title: Legal Counsel - Commercial Contracting
Description:
### **Welcome to PxGeo**

PxGeo is an international offshore geophysical services company providing seismic data acquisition and related services to the energy industry. The Group operates across multiple jurisdictions with a head office in Dubai and manages projects in a complex and highly regulated environment.

PxGeo’s operations involve an extensive international supply chain, including vessel chartering, specialist equipment and technology, offshore services, logistics, and a broad range of suppliers and contractors. The Legal function supports commercial arrangements across multiple countries and legal frameworks, with a significant proportion of the Group’s contracts governed by English law.

### **What's the role?**

Official job title is Legal Counsel - Commercial Contracting and will be based in Dubai, UAE.

This position provides senior-level legal support to PxGeo’s commercial, operational and Supply Chain activities.

The role will take ownership of complex and strategically important commercial agreements, provide practical and commercially focused legal advice throughout the contracting lifecycle, and support the development of consistent contracting standards across the Group.

The successful candidate will work closely with Operations, Technical Solutions, Finance, Supply Chain, Sales and other business functions. The role requires the ability to lead contractual negotiations independently, identify and communicate material legal and commercial risks, and develop workable solutions that support PxGeo’s operational objectives while appropriately protecting the Group’s interests. Key responsibilities include:  
  
**Commercial Contracting**

* Lead the drafting, review and negotiation of complex, high-value and strategically significant commercial agreements.
* Provide legal support in connection with contracts relating to:
* + offshore and seismic services; vessel chartering and marine services;
  + specialist equipment and technology; equipment supply, rental, hire and leasing;
  + agency, logistics, freight and transportation; consultancy and contractor services;
  + software, technology and licensing; framework and master services agreements;
  + purchase orders and associated contractual documentation; and
  + other operational and project-related arrangements.
* Lead negotiations with customers, suppliers, contractors and other commercial counterparties.
* Review and negotiate amendments to PxGeo’s Terms & Conditions.
* Review and negotiate counterparties’ standard terms where PxGeo’s contractual documentation cannot be used.
* Advise on contractual structures and appropriate risk allocation, including:
* + liability and indemnities; consequential and indirect loss;
  + warranties and performance obligations; insurance requirements;
  + intellectual property and data rights; payment and security arrangements;
  + delivery, acceptance and delay; liquidated damages;
  + suspension and termination; force majeure;
  + regulatory compliance; governing law and dispute resolution.
* Provide practical advice on contractual interpretation, contract performance and operational issues arising during project delivery.
* Support the management and resolution of commercial claims and disputes before escalation to formal proceedings.
* Coordinate with external legal counsel where specialist or jurisdiction-specific advice is required.

**Business and Project Support**

* Act as a senior Legal point of contact for commercial and operational matters.
* Work closely with business teams to understand the technical, operational and commercial context of proposed arrangements.
* Participate in project, tender and negotiation meetings where legal input is required.
* Support the identification and management of contractual risks during the tendering, negotiation, mobilisation and performance stages.
* Advise management on material contractual exposures and available mitigation measures.
* Support the development of negotiation strategies for complex or sensitive matters.
* Promote early engagement with Legal so that material risks are identified before commercial positions are agreed.

**Contracting Standards and Legal Processes**

* Support the development, maintenance and implementation of PxGeo’s standard contracts, templates, contractual guidance and fallback positions.
* Contribute to the standardisation and continuous improvement of commercial contracting processes.
* Support efficient workflows and escalation routes between Legal and other functions.
* Provide guidance and support to Legal Counsel/Paralegal and other members of the Legal team on commercial contracting matters.
* Deliver practical training to relevant business functions on contractual risk and contracting procedures.
* Support with other commercial, corporate or strategic matters as required.

### **Who are we looking for?**

* Qualified lawyer with substantial 9+ post-qualification experience, although the quality and relevance of experience will be more important than the precise number of years.
* Bachelor’s Degree in Law (LLB) or Master’s Degree in Law (LLM). English law qualification is desirable but not essential, provided the candidate has strong practical experience with common law commercial contracts.
* Strong experience in drafting, reviewing and negotiating complex commercial agreements governed by English law or based on English common law principles.
* Demonstrated ability to lead contractual negotiations independently and engage effectively with senior internal stakeholders and external counterparties.
* Detailed understanding of commercial risk allocation.
* Ability to understand technical and operational requirements and translate them into workable contractual arrangements.
* Strong commercial judgment and the ability to distinguish material legal risks from matters that can be managed operationally.
* Excellent negotiation and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple complex and time-sensitive matters with limited supervision.
* Excellent written and spoken English.
* Experience in one or more of the following would be advantageous:
* + energy or oil and gas; offshore services; seismic or geophysical services; marine or shipping; vessel chartering; procurement and Supply Chain contracting; or international project-based operations.
* Previous in-house experience within an international, operational or project-based organisation would be a strong advantage.

Title: Technician, Maintenance Quality Assurance
Description:
Job Summary:

Reporting to the Manager, Maintenance Quality Assurance, and supported by the Supervisor, Maintenance Quality Assurance; this position engages in the daily conduct and continuous improvement of auditing activities within the Maintenance Quality Assurance Program (MQAP) established under Porter Airlines’ AMO / AOC / ATO certificates. This position also supports Porter Airlines’ safety culture by participating in core functions related to the internal Safety Management System (SMS).

Duties & Responsibilities:

* **Internal Audit Planning:** Engage in the planning and conduct of internal audits encompassing all functions and elements necessary to confirm compliance with applicable Canadian regulations and approved manuals.
* **External Audit Planning:** Engage in the planning and conduct of external audits of contracted organizations including but not limited to aircraft maintenance arrangements, manufacturers, suppliers, and overhaul/repair facilities, etc.
* **Design Audit Checklists:** Design and develop detailed audit checklists encompassing all applicable functions and elements under Canadian Aviation Regulations (CARs) and Porter Airlines’ approved company manuals, including all functions related to contracted external organizations.
* **Ensure IOSA Conformance:** Ensure that audits and checklists are in conformance with any applicable IOSA Standards and Recommended Practices (ISARPs).
* **Audit Follow-up / Closure:** Review and/or recommend corrective action plan (CAP) submissions, audit sample dispositions, and process improvements. Ensure audit progress is conducted in a timely manner with follow-ups for CAP effectiveness and final audit closure.
* **Corporate Policy Compliance:** Adhere to all applicable processes and procedures specified in Porter’s Corporate Operations Manual, MPM, MCM, SMS Manual and Audit Manual.
* **Inter-Departmental Teamwork:** Engage in MQA’s regular team meetings, MQAP Workshop meetings and Quarterly “All Teams” meetings. Engage in various inter-departmental team meetings as may be required.
* **SMS Investigations:** Conduct SMS investigations including root cause analysis and the development of corrective action plans (after SMS Investigator training has been provided internally).
* **SMS General Participation:** Actively participate in Porter’s Safety Management System (SMS) including reporting hazards and incidents encountered in daily operations and/or resulting from the MQAP; understand, comply with, and promote the Company Safety Policy.
* **Other:** Occasional tasks assigned.

Behavioural Competencies:

* **Concern for Safety:** Identifying hazardous or potentially hazardous situations and taking appropriate action to maintain a safe environment for self and others.
* **Teamwork:** Working collaboratively with others to achieve organizational goals.
* **Passenger/Customer Service:** Providing service excellence to internal and/or external customers (passengers).
* **Initiative:** Dealing with situations and issues proactively and persistently, seizing opportunities that arise.
* **Results Focus:** Focusing efforts on achieving high quality results consistent with the organization’s standards.
* **Fostering Communication:** Listening and communicating openly, honestly, and respectfully with different audiences, promoting dialogue and building consensus.

Qualifications:

* Post-secondary education in an aviation related field, or equivalent education / experience is required.
* Recognized Internal Auditor training certificate (such as ISO 9001), current within the past two years is required.
* 2+ years of aviation and QA experience, with applicable training certification/s while working in an AMO or AOC or MRO environment is required.
* Ability to obtain and maintain necessary airport security clearance is required.
* Must maintain a valid passport (plus any necessary long-term visa for USA) and be able to travel to various locations worldwide when required.
* Knowledge of TCCA’s Canadian Aviation Regulations (CARs) is required.
* Knowledge of FAA’s Federal Aviation Regulations (FARs) is required.
* Knowledge/experience in IOSA auditing principles and ISARPs is a key asset.
* Knowledge/experience in AMOS (maintenance management software) is a key asset.
* Familiarity with various Technical Data sources (AMM, AIPC, CMM, MTCM) is a key asset.
* Experience in leading an audit team or a team conducting detailed engineering inspections is a key asset.
* Impartiality, integrity, tenacity, diplomacy and self-reliance are key attributes for this role.
* Excellence in time management, written and verbal communication skills, keen attention to detail.

Company Description:

Since 2006, Porter Airlines has been elevating the experience of economy air travel for every passenger, providing genuine hospitality with style, care and charm. Porter’s fleet of Embraer E195-E2 and De Havilland Dash 8-400 aircraft serves North America, including a coast-to-coast domestic Canadian network, the U.S., Mexico, the Caribbean and Central America. Headquartered in Toronto, Porter is an Official 4 Star Airline® in the World Airline Star Rating®. Visit www.flyporter.com or follow @porterairlines on Instagram, Facebook and X.

Title: Safety Engineer
Description:
Core Role and Responsibilities:

* Execute the Project HSE Plan, method statements, risk assessments (JSA/HAZID), and

COSHH controls; maintain evidence of competence and ensure resources for HSE are

adequate and sustained throughout the works

* Maintain all HSE documentation, including audit and inspection reports, and ensure

compliance with all KAHRAMAA and national HSE requirements.

* Participate in toolbox talks, safety briefings ,attend meetings, training sessions, and

workshops as required by KAHRAMAA.

* Enforce KAHRAMAA HSE rules at sites; support the HSE Manager/Coordinator in

developing the training matrix, audit/inspection plans, and coordination with KAHRAMAA on

HSE matters.

* Conduct site HSE inductions; lead toolbox talks; deliver/arrange topic-specific training

(Emergency Response & Preparedness, HAZMAT, Confined Space, Working at Height,

Lockout/Tagout, Electrical Safety, Lifting & Rigging, Power Tool Safety, Excavation Safety,

PPE, Waste Management, Incident Reporting & Investigation, Root Cause Analysis)

* Ensure appropriate PPE is issued, conforms to KAHRAMAA requirements, and is

inspected/maintained regularly (helmets, shoes, goggles/face shields, dust goggles, gloves,

harnesses/lifelines.)

* Maintain site housekeeping and safe storage/handling of materials, including

flammable/hazardous substances; implement controls for hot-work and welding areas with

suitable firefighting equipment.

* Keep portable firefighting equipment available on site from commencement to takeover;

ensure maintenance and mandatory weekly checks; recharge after use and manage stocks

of fresh charges; control open flames and flammable materials per KAHRAMAA instructions.

* Immediately notify KAHRAMAA of accidents/near misses; secure the site/witnesses; submit

Initial Incident Report and final investigation report as per KAHRAMAA guidelines.

Keep accident logs, patient/illness records, and periodic medical exam reporting as required

by national regulations referenced by KAHRAMAA.

* Execute planned audits/inspections; issue NCRs; drive corrective/preventive actions;

escalate unresolved hazards; exercise stop-work authority where necessary; track closure

and communicate changes to personnel

* Oversee electrical safety controls during installation, replacement, testing, commissioning,

and maintenance of LV and HV electricity meters and communication modules, including

working-at-height, energized work controls, lockout/tagout, and safe cabling/antenna

installation in poor-signal areas (subject to KAHRAMAA approval)

* Ensure use of dedicated communication signal strength analyzers (no mobile apps

permitted) when validating AMI communications; coordinate safe handling/transport/storage

of assets with KAHRAMAA access for inspection.

* Maintain daily/weekly/monthly safety reports, inspection logs, incident registers, training

records, and PPE registers; support project progress reporting cadence and WBS execution

phases (Engineering/Procurement/Execution/Close-out) with HSE inputs.

* Provide hard/soft copies of HSE documentation for audits and at KAHRAMAA’s request.

* Coordinate with KAHRAMAA HSE Department, line departments, customers, contractors,

and telecom providers for shutdowns, emergency works, and multi-site mobilization;

participate in emergency drills and ensure readiness of response teams.

* Maintain availability across three shifts in a 24×7 environment; travel between venues/depots

during and outside office hours for inspections, incident response, and verification of

corrective actions (as operationally required).

***Qualification & experience***

* Bachelor’s degree in Fire & Safety, Electrical, Mechanical, or Chemical Engineering (or

related discipline);

* KAHRAMAA-approved First Aid and Basic Fire Fighting certificates required; ISO

45001/14001 Lead Auditor, Risk Management (QRA/JSA/HAZID) training preferred.

* Demonstrated experience in Construction/Industrial Safety within utility/infrastructure

projects; ability to coordinate and manage HSE issues, conduct audits/incident

investigations, and apply applicable national/international HSE laws.

* Hands-on experience supporting metering roll-outs (including LV/HV Electricity meters) and

AMI field operations with safe methods of work and compliance to KAHRAMAA procedure.

Pay: QAR8,000.00 - QAR11,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

Title: AI Enablement Engineer
Description:

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

**The Role**

As an AI Enablement Engineer, you will serve as the crucial bridge between our enterprise Artificial Intelligence platforms and our workforce. You will drive the adoption, effective utilization, and value realization of generative AI and intelligent productivity tools across the organization.

This is a highly strategic and user-centric role. You will not be responsible for coding, model training, or backend engineering. Instead, your focus will be on human-centric AI adoption: ensuring our teams know how to use these technologies, understand their evolving capabilities, and integrate them seamlessly into their daily workflows to maximize business value.

User Onboarding & Adoption

Capabilities Roadmap & Strategy

User Training & Education

* Create and deliver engaging training sessions, workshops, and webinars tailored to various technical proficiency levels.
* Develop best-practice resources, such as advanced prompt engineering libraries and functional workflow templates.
* Establish and manage a community of "AI Champions" across different departments to foster peer-to-peer learning.
* Support end-to-end platform delivery by ensuring users are equipped to adopt new tools through structured enablement and guided usage practices.
* Support the delivery and rollout of new platforms, ensuring smooth transition from implementation to user adoption.

  

User Support & Feedback Loop

* Serve as the primary functional point of contact for user questions, best-practice inquiries, and workflow troubleshooting.
* Triage technical bugs or system outages to the core technical engineering/IT teams.
* Gather, synthesize, and advocate for user feedback to shape future AI rollouts and training initiatives.
* Continuously improve workflows and user experience based on feedback gathered during post-implementation support.
* Perform functional validation and testing to ensure solutions align with business requirements and deliver expected user outcomes.

  

Value Realization & Metrics

* Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) related to AI adoption, active usage, and user sentiment.

* 7+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, technology delivery, architecture, digital transformation, AI enablement or a related technology discipline.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* **Tech Fluency:** Strong conceptual understanding of Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and enterprise productivity suites. No coding or backend development experience is required.

* **Communication:** Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technological concepts into simple, business-friendly language.
* **Empathy:** A user-first mindset with a strong ability to understand and address the frustrations, fears, or hurdles employees face when adopting disruptive technologies.
