Title: Division Chief - Pediatric Endocrinology
Description:
**JOB SUMMARY**

The Division Chief - Endocrinology reporting to the Executive Chair - Medicine provides clinical, education, research and executive management leadership in Endocrinology. The Division Chief is a clinical and managerial leader working with the Sidra executive team to develop and deliver strategy and business plans and is accountable for resources and performance in Endocrinology and integrates research and education priorities into a program of excellent clinical service delivery, specialized outpatient clinical services including diagnostic and therapeutic procedures for complex and complicated procedures, consultations and case management, and other associated clinical and academic activites. The Division Chief continues with personal clinical education and research activities albeit in a reduced and modified manner, and will have a full-time appointment to Weill Cornell Medical College – Qatar and hold the position of Associate Professor or Professor of Pediatrics - Endocrinology.

**KEY ROLE ACCOUNTABILITIES**

* Takes decision related to budgeting and budget controlling mechanism for the Endocrinology Division
* Makes decisions impacting recruitment and management of staff in the division.
* Drives the strategic plan for the division and contributes towards the strategic plan of the department.
* Coaches, mentors and monitors staff performance.
* Supports and takes decisions related to educational, clinical & research activities of the Endocrinology Division.
* Identifies and articulates the vision, strategic direction, and growth of the Division of Endocrinology and collaborates on the implementation of strategies to achieve them.
* Leads clinical service planning, service development and capacity planning for the Outpatient/Inpatient activities of Endocrinology services.
* Promotes leadership and direction for the development of strategies to promote the recruitment, retention, and directs mission of excellence for the medical staff, and collaborates with the Division Chiefs to execute the strategies.
* Recommends clinical privileges, appointment, reappointment and corrective action for each member of the Division of Endocrinology as well as promoting mentorship and academic career development for these staff members.
* Responsible for all administrative activities of the Endocrinology Division unless otherwise provided for by the hospital, and serves on all requested committees including medical executive committee, and appointing such committees as necessary to conduct the function of the department.
* Develops and implements policies and procedures that guide support provision of services to the Endocrinology Clinic services.
* Continues surveillance of the professional performance of all individuals in the Endocrinology Division who have delineated clinical privileges, including performance, and ongoing and focused professional practice evaluations (OPPE and FPPE).
* Continues surveillance of patient care and the professional performance of all individuals in the Endocrinology Division who have defined clinical privileges.
* Ensures that the staff of the Endocrinology Division provides services that are in compliance with all applicable standards and requirements of the Joint Commission International, Qatar Supreme Council of Health, and all other applicable regulatory bodies.
* Accountable for the financial performance and management of all budgets within the Endocrinology Division.
* Implements the clinical service strategies and business plan for the Endocrinology Division.
* Makes recommendations for the purchase of capital and other equipment and participates in the evaluation of products for use by different members of the Endocrinology Division to ensure their safety and efficacy.
* Sets and achieves targets to drive continuous assessment and improvement of the quality of care and services provided and initiates actions for necessary improvements according to Sidra Board initiatives.
* Works with the Chair - Pediatrics to establish and update the work week standards for all physicians and staff and assures that there is appropriate clinical coverage for all patients requiring medical care from the Endocrinology Division (including emergency care).
* Ensures all members of the Endocrinology Division optimize the use of electronic medical records.
* Sets and achieves targets for programs and procedures for confidentiality of all patient information in accordance with hospital policy and the privacy laws of the State of Qatar.
* In conjunction with the Clinical Service Chief, ensures the implementation of robust clinical governance structures and processes to ensure patient safety.
* In conjunction with the Chief Research Officer and division heads of research, ensures a program of clinical and translational research is developed and promoted and delivered within the Endocrinology Division.
* In conjunction with the Dean of Weill Cornell Medical College – Qatar ensures there is an active and continuous program of undergraduate teaching within the Endocrinology Division to ensure an effective learning environment for students, residents, and medical staff.
* Involves in research, graduate teaching, and publication in higher impact refereed journals, advising fellows, and students and participates in academic services.
* Ensures effective communication with and involvement of all staff within the Endocrinology Division in regards to key decisions and initiatives.
* Works collaboratively with other service chiefs, chief officers, and executive directors to achieve broad Sidra objectives.
* Conducts other duties as may be directed by the Chief Medical Officer and/or Chief Executive Officer.
* Initiates, implements and oversees programs designed to foster positive relations between Endocrinology physicians and the hospital operations and administration.
* Assists with marketing strategies to inform physicians and their staff of Sidra’s clinical diagnostic procedures, services and resources.
* Promotes and evaluates physician community outreach programs as appropriate.
* Develops, manages and supports physician and community relationships, coordinating and disseminating information to all stakeholders to solicit ongoing support from the State of Qatar for Endocrinology.

**QUALIFICATION & EXPERIENCE**

**Education**

* MD degree
* Residency training in Pediatrics
* Fellowship in Pediatric Endocrinology

**Experience**

* 10+ years clinical experience
* 5+ years in Academic leadership as section chief or chief of Endocrinology

Join a dynamic consulting environment supporting major healthcare capital redevelopment, operational readiness, and transition planning initiatives. This role provides the opportunity to work closely with hospital and healthcare leaders, guiding organizations through complex change to achieve safe, efficient, and sustainable operations. You will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, contribute to high‑impact planning, and serve as a trusted advisor during all phases of capital, activation, and transformation projects.

Your Key Responsibilities

* Lead operational readiness and transition planning for multi‑site, multi‑phase hospital redevelopment projects, including workflow redesign, readiness assessments, simulation planning, and activation preparation.

* Provide expert advice on crisis management, contingency planning, and operational risk reduction during periods of disruption.

* Prepare concise written reports and deliver presentations to client teams, ensuring clarity, insight, and value‑added recommendations.

Your Capabilities and Credentials

* Strategic, systems‑level thinker with strong analytical and problem‑solving skills.

* Deep healthcare operational knowledge with the ability to identify options, alternatives, and solutions that support client objectives.

* Exceptional communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to build trust‑based relationships and lead diverse teams through change.

* Experienced in stakeholder engagement, change leadership, conflict resolution, and coaching.

* Innovative, adaptable, and detail‑oriented, able to manage multiple priorities and navigate ambiguity in fast‑paced environments.

* Proficient in MS Office, including advanced use of PowerPoint, Excel, and Visio.

* Comfortable working in a mobile, multi‑site environment with flexibility for travel and extended hours as required.

Education and Experience

* Minimum 5 years of progressive leadership experience in hospitals, including oversight of clinical or clinical support services.

* Demonstrated Director‑level experience in operational readiness for brownfield and greenfield redevelopment projects.

* Proven success leading large, complex, multi‑year redevelopment initiatives involving IT integration, workflow redesign, and operational transformation.

* Project Management Professional (PMP) designation; Lean certification an asset.

* Experience with simulation‑based readiness planning, digital health implementation, or clinical informatics is an asset.

* Valid driver’s license and comfort working across office and client sites.

Title: Digital Practice Specialist – BIM/VDC
Description:
Stantec’s Buildings team is on a mission to become the world’s leading integrated design practice. Our architects, engineers, interior designers, consultants, sustainability specialists, and technologists are passionate about the power of design. Our collaborative culture and our innovative, sustainable approach to projects help us create buildings that matter to our world.

Together, we are enhancing the quality of life globally through design.

Join us and design your place with Stantec.

The Digital Practice Specialist – BIM/VDC provides leadership, technical expertise, and coordination for digital delivery, BIM, model-based design, and engineering information management across Buildings projects. The role supports project teams in implementing modern digital delivery practices, improving collaboration, advancing model-based workflows, and enabling successful delivery through platforms such as Revit and Autodesk.

Working across disciplines, business centers, and joint venture partners, the Digital Practice Specialist serves as a trusted advisor for digital strategy, BIM implementation, common data environments, model governance, interoperability, and technical workflow development. The position promotes consistency, quality, and innovation while helping project teams adopt efficient and scalable digital delivery solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Digital Delivery & BIM Leadership

* Lead multidisciplinary clash detection and model coordination using Autodesk Navisworks Manage, with Revizto or similar platforms used as appropriate.
* Facilitate recurring coordination meetings to review constructability and model conflicts, establish responsible parties, and drive issues toward resolution.
* Lead implementation of BIM and digital delivery workflows on major multidisciplinary buildings projects.
* To proactively identify and resolve Model Coordination conflicts in the digital model before construction begins, reducing downstream disruptions and improving collaboration with contractors who are increasingly performing their own VDC.
* Support development and maintenance of Digital Project Execution Plans (DPxP), BIM execution strategies, and project digital delivery requirements.
* Establish governance, standards, naming conventions, model management processes, and information management workflows.
* Facilitate BIM coordination activities across internal and external project teams.

Common Data Environment & Information Management

* Support deployment, configuration, and administration of Revit and Autodesk environments.

* Promote effective use of common data environments and single-source-of-truth principles
* Collaborate with the Infrastructure Digital Practice (IDP) Services and Solutions Managers, to provide overall design software support services.

Technical Delivery & Workflow Development

* Autodesk AEC applications including Revit, InfraWorks, Inventor, Autodesk Forma Cloud
* Develop standard operating procedures (SOPs), workflow documentation, training materials, and implementation guidance.
* Troubleshoot complex BIM, CAD, model management, interoperability, and data exchange issues.
* Support integration between Revit and Autodesk ecosystems and other connected digital platforms.
* Develop and maintain clash detection tests across federated discipline models, reviewing results to identify actionable coordination and constructability issues.

Training, Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing

* Lead technical workshops, user groups, BIM coordination meetings, and project-specific training sessions.
* Mentor project teams on digital delivery best practices and emerging technologies.
* Develop and deliver demonstrations, educational content, and adoption resources to increase digital capability across the organization.
* Foster collaboration among project teams, digital practice leaders, software vendors, and external partners.

Strategic Project Support

* Provide digital leadership for major programs requiring multidisciplinary coordination and advanced model-based delivery.
* Support quality assurance, model review, clash detection initiatives, model governance, and coordination reviews.
* Evaluate and recommend process improvements that increase efficiency, reduce risk, and enhance project delivery outcomes.
* Represent Infrastructure Digital Practice in project planning, client discussions, and industry-facing digital initiatives.
* Assist with proposals and help position Digital Practice capabilities in pursuit efforts

Technical & Digital Skills

* 5+ years of experience in infrastructure digital delivery, BIM, major projects, and digital project execution.
* Demonstrated experience with Revit and Autodesk digital delivery platforms
* Strong communication, facilitation, training, and stakeholder engagement skills.
* Ability to lead cross-functional teams and implement digital transformation initiatives across large, complex projects.

* Experience supporting buildings, engineering, or consulting delivery environments

* Experience tracking coordination issues, ownership, status, and follow-up through resolution.

Professional Attributes

* Ability to connect technical solutions to real-world delivery challenges
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Proactive, adaptable, and delivery-focused mindset

Title: Chief of Support Services
Description:
Job Responsibilities
  
  
The South Carolina Legislative Services Agency (LSA) is seeking an experienced and strategic Chief of Support Services Manager to lead and oversee all service-oriented operations supporting the South Carolina General Assembly. This position provides executive-level leadership support services including service desk, media support, legislative process, and information management and training, all within a non-partisan and apolitical environment.
  
  
The Chief of Support Services Manager is accountable for ensuring exceptional customer service delivery across all support services by providing reliable, intuitive, and secure technology and operational support. This role is responsible for reducing service friction, improving user experience, and ensuring that service outcomes are measurable, transparent, and aligned with legislative business needs.
  
  
The Chief of Support Services Manager serves as a trusted advisor to agency leadership and plays a critical role in aligning service delivery and operational planning with the mission and strategic goals of LSA. This role blends leadership, operational oversight, business analysis, and will work closely with project management to ensure high-quality, efficient, and innovative support services for the House of Representatives, Senate, and Legislative Council.
  
  
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**

* Provide executive leadership and strategic oversight for all support services departments, ensuring streamlined, reliable, and responsive operations.
* Serve as the senior authority for service management initiatives, guiding planning, prioritization, and execution of operational and technology-related services.
* Act as a trusted advisor to the Agency Director on service delivery, operational effectiveness, organizational readiness, and change management.
* Lead and manage cross-functional teams, fostering collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Conduct comprehensive business, workflow, and service function analyses, including needs assessments and change impact evaluations.
* Define, recommend, and implement operational and service improvements using best-practice business processes and methodologies.
* Collaborate with the Senior Project Management lead for major agency initiatives, overseeing scope, schedules, risks, dependencies, and reporting to executive leadership.
* Lead the planning and implementation of special initiatives to support legislative bodies as they adapt to new technologies, methodologies, and lifecycle replacements.
* Develop and maintain operational documentation, service frameworks, performance metrics, and improvement workflows.
* Partner with division and team managers to identify current and future projects, resource needs, and service priorities.
* Promote a culture of professionalism, service excellence, innovation, and accountability across all support services functions.
* Ensure all activities support the mission of LSA in a non-political, non-partisan, and behind-the-scenes capacity.

**Customer Service Delivery & Excellence**

* Ensure support services operate with a customer-first mindset, delivering reliable, intuitive, and secure services that meet the needs of legislative staff and stakeholders.
* Drive continuous improvement in user experience by reducing service friction, improving response times, and proactively addressing recurring issues.
* Translate technical and operational decisions into clear business value that users can understand and experience.
* Own major service incidents and escalations end-to-end, ensuring timely communication, resolution, and post-incident review to prevent repeat occurrences.
* Serve as a visible, calm, and credible leader during service disruptions, setting expectations and communicating status, impacts, and resolutions in clear, non-technical language.
* Define, implement, and monitor service level agreements (SLAs), key performance indicators (KPIs), and performance dashboards to measure service reliability, responsiveness, and quality.
* Balance speed, quality, security, and compliance when delivering services and making operational decisions.
* Collect and analyze user feedback, service trends, and performance data to proactively improve services before issues escalate.
* Champion automation, self-service tools, and process improvements that enhance efficiency while maintaining service quality.

**Management & Leadership Responsibilities**

* Build, mentor, and retain high-performing service-oriented teams with a strong emphasis on professionalism, accountability, and customer service excellence.
* Coach staff in both technical competencies and soft skills, including communication, empathy, and stakeholder engagement.
* Establish clear roles, ownership, escalation paths, and accountability across support services teams.
* Act as the final escalation point for vendors and third-party partners, ensuring service commitments and performance expectations are met.

Manage service-related budgets and resources responsibly, justifying expenditures through demonstrated service outcomes
  
  
**Minimum And Additional Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in business management, computer science, information management, or another IT or business-related field.
* Minimum of five (5) years of progressive experience in:

+ IT business analysis
+ Project or program management
+ Personnel or team leadership

**Additional Requirements**

* Extensive knowledge of business analysis techniques, needs assessments, and change management principles.
* Strong leadership and personnel management skills with the ability to inspire, mentor, and develop teams.
* Advanced support services skills with the ability to independently drive initiatives from concept through completion.
* Exceptional planning, facilitation, communication, interpersonal, and influencing skills.
* Ability to understand both high-level strategic objectives and detailed operational requirements.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and conflict management skills.
* Proficiency in SharePoint, Microsoft Office, and IT support services methodologies, with demonstrated adaptability and a willingness to learn and support emerging AI technologies and models as the agency evolves.
* Excellent written communication skills for executive reporting, technical documentation, and professional correspondence.
* Excellent verbal communication skills with a professional appearance and demeanor.
* Ability to logically analyze complex problems and develop practical, sustainable solutions.
* Ability to set priorities based on the unique needs of the House, Senate, and Legislative Council.
* Must be personable, polite, respectful, flexible, open-minded, and non-judgmental.
* Must be comfortable working in a non-political, behind-the-scenes support role.
* Strong customer service orientation with the ability to balance user expectations, operational constraints, and organizational priorities.
* Proven ability to explain complex technical or operational issues in plain language to non-technical stakeholders.
* Demonstrated experience managing incidents, escalations, and service recovery in high-visibility environments.
* Ability to make decisive, accountable decisions under pressure while maintaining professionalism and trust.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* ITIL Foundation Certification (must be certified within a year of hire)
* Lean Six Sigma Certification (Green belt or higher).
* Experience working in a legislative, judicial, or government agency environment.

Experience establishing or improving
**service metrics, SLAs, KPIs, and performance dashboards**
Additional Comments
  
  
This is an onsite position operating within a professional government environment supporting the South Carolina General Assembly. The role requires frequent collaboration with executive leadership, technical teams, and service-oriented departments while maintaining strict non-partisanship and political neutrality. The work is mission-driven, service-focused, and essential to effective legislative operations. Success in this role requires a customer-first mindset, strong decision-making under pressure, clear and consistent communication, accountability and empathy for both service users and staff.

Title: Transport Coordinator
Description:
##### **Job Purpose**

Join our Transport Services team, where you will play a key role in managing and optimizing our fleet and transportation operations. The team is responsible for ensuring safe, efficient, and on-time performance through quality control, route management, transport assessments, and continuous improvements our transportation standards.

If you are passionate about logistics, operational efficiency, and upholding the highest health and safety standards, we invite you to apply and contribute to the success of Emirates Group. As part of the world’s largest international airline, our transport services team is essential in keeping our operations running smoothly and efficiently every day.

As a **Transport Coordinator** , you will be responsible for creating, updating, and maintaining vehicle records in CSTMS (Central Service Transport Management System) throughout the entire vehicle lifecycle, from inception to disposal, ensuring data accuracy and compliance with all system requirements. Generate reports and maintain comprehensive records of vehicle-related costs, monitor expenditures, reconcile pending issues, and ensure timely resolution of discrepancies. Coordinate application upgrades and system enhancements in line with operational requirements to improve efficiency. Liaise with vehicle users to identify and assess repair requirements based on reported non-technical information, conduct preliminary assessments, and assist senior management in establishing higher repair standards by recommending effective and economical solutions. Ensure efficient coordination of vehicle maintenance and repairs while maintaining cost control and optimal fleet performance.

**In this role, you will:**

* Maintain accurate and comprehensive vehicle records in CSTMS (Central Service Transport Management System) from inception to disposal. Records include vehicle specifications, user details, registration, insurance, and fuel card information. Exercise utmost care when entering technical data, as certain information cannot be amended once entered.
* Arrange repair appointments, prepare Repair Request Forms (RRFs) using appropriate technical terminology, coordinate drivers for vehicle delivery, and arrange collection upon completion of repairs. Ensure effective scheduling to minimise delays and allow sufficient time for repairs.
* Assist in inspecting vehicles and identifying technical faults within the Central Services fleet. Interpret reported problems from users who may lack technical knowledge and translate them into accurate automotive terminology to facilitate effective repairs while saving time and costs.
* Liaise with workshops to ensure accurate, timely, and cost-effective repairs. Obtain repair estimates and approvals from user departments, communicate approvals to workshops, follow up on repair progress, and ensure all relevant transactions are updated in CSTMS.
* Ensure timely collection and accurate uploading of workshop and agency invoices into CSTMS. Coordinate with IT and workshops to resolve data errors during invoice downloads, ensuring complete reconciliation with corresponding RRFs. Manually process invoices received from agencies and other garages on an invoice-by-invoice basis.
* Coordinate with internal departments regarding vehicle registration renewals, Traffic Department repair recommendations, accident-related repairs, and settlement of fines. Liaise with insurance companies, tyre suppliers, and EPPCO for insurance-related matters, tyre requirements, and fuel card issuance or cancellation.
* Assist senior management in preparing exception reports, analysing data, preparing case notes, and communicating findings. Monitor registration renewals, fuel card issuance, quotations, invoice verification, and CSTMS records to prevent overcharging and ensure cost-effective repairs and quality workmanship.
* Maintain comprehensive records of vehicle servicing, registration, insurance documents, invoices, accident reports, and other vehicle-related correspondence. Ensure timely communication of company vehicle user details to HR, Management Accounts, and Payroll.
* Provide technical guidance to user departments and workshops, as required, to ensure repairs meet the required standards. Advise vehicle users on appropriate vehicle care following major repairs, including engine and air-conditioning system overhauls.
* Prepare vehicle handover and takeover checklists, conduct random inspections of the Central Services fleet, and prepare snag lists. In the absence of available resources, arrange or personally undertake vehicle delivery and collection to and from workshops or senior managers' residences, as required.

##### **Qualification**

**To be considered for the role, you must meet the below requirements:**

* Have completed 12 years of schooling or equivalent.
Have at least 5 years of experience working in Supply Chain, Logistics or Transport.  

  

**You will have an edge if you have:**

* Have experience working with Resource Management Systems (RMS), Real-Time Control (RTC), Multi-Access Check-in System.
* Have experience working with Microsoft Office Applications.

Emirates Group is an international organisation with employees from over 170 nationalities; we encourage applications from across the globe. If you meet the criteria of the role, you will then be invited to complete a HireVue video interview, to share more about your experience and your career aspirations. If you are shortlisted, you will then be invited to interview with our hiring managers. If you are successful, your recruiter will reach out to you with an offer and then our Onboarding team will ensure a smooth transition to your new role at Emirates Group.

Join us in Dubai and enjoy an attractive tax-free salary and travel benefits that are exclusive to our industry, including discounts in flights and hotels stays around the world. Title: Cargo Charter Support Officer
Description:
##### **Job Purpose**

A World leader in air cargo. We possess a geographical advantage that enables us to reach over 140 destinations across 6 continents. We are able to cater to two-thirds of the world’s population in just 8 hours and serve major international trade regions quickly and efficiently. Our SkyCargo group works in partnership to facilitate global trade and connect customers with their destinations. We have a young, efficient, wide-bodied fleet, with ample capacity to transport cargo through our

state-of-the-a

rt, multi-airport hub in Dubai and adapt to our customers ever-changing needs.

  

As Cargo Charter Support Officer, you provide dedicated and specialised support to the three areas in EK Cargo Freighters **and Charter Operations** .

Undertake planning, coordination and implementation of all matters relating to Freighter operation in SkyCargo. This includes all aspects of charter operations, ensuring both operational and commercial integrity is maintained while meeting all safety, quality and customer service standards.

Ensure that all activities take place in an effective and efficient manner so as to ensure all **freighter and charter services** are adequately covered especially at times of schedule disruptions, schedule adjustments, additional operations and new route introductions.

Undertake the management of other aspects of Freighter Department including **charter-related system requirements** .

In this role, you will:

* SCHEDULE PLANNING:
    
  Prepare seasonal freighter schedules in a timely manner ensuring all commercial and operational requirements are met. Ensure all permissions and permits are obtained from government and other agencies for the smooth operation of scheduled freighter services **and charter operations** for incorporation and publication in the quarterly airline timetable so that the freighter network information is available to customers. Provide support to the Cargo Scheduling & Planning Manager in slot co-ordination activity especially from an operational perspective when additional charter flights are operated or obtaining specific slots during schedule disruptions so as to be able maintain the required performance level on slot utilisation such that slot historic are protected.
    
  Monitor the schedules of all the freighters and charter flights ensuring its effectiveness and efficiency so that all services are adequately covered especially at times of schedule disruptions, adjustments to schedules and additional operations.

* OPERATIONS PLANNING:
* Coordinate monthly freighter schedules with the wet lease aircraft operators (Atlas Air, TNT and others) ensuring that the operator is provided monthly schedules in a timely manner and that the operator is able to fulfil Emirates schedules, **including supporting charter flight requirements where applicable** .

  Coordinate monthly freighter schedules with other Emirates operational departments ensuring that they are provided in a timely manner and that Emirates is capable of fulfilling them. This also requires checking back with the operator to ensure that the operator's planning information reflect Emirates requirements **for both freighter and charter operations** .

  When special charter flights are operated, the job holder is required to travel to outstations, especially off-line stations and/or stations that do not have freighter expertise, to ensure all operational activity in relation to the charter is performed according to company standards and customer's satisfaction.

  **Support the operational planning and coordination of ad-hoc charter flights, ensuring all stakeholder requirements are met before, during and after operation.**
* DEVELOPMENT & ANALYSIS:
* Manage all other carrier (OAL) block space agreements ensuring that agreements are current and where renewal is due initiate renewal negotiations.

  Assist in the negotiate with carriers with block space agreements for the optimal cancellations in accordance with agreed cancellation allowances, so as to ensure Emirates commercial objectives are not compromised.

  Undertake planning, operations within the Freighter department, with regard to medium and long term freighter and charter operations ensuring operational integrity is maintained while meeting all safety, quality and customer service standards.

  **Conduct charter feasibility assessments including operational constraints, airport capabilities, slots, permits, aircraft suitability and customer requirements.**
* GENERIC (TO ALL 3 AREAS):
* Identify requirements that need to be incorporated into the New Generation Cargo System (NGSC) on an ongoing basis for the effective and efficient management of all freighter and charter related activity prioritising the necessary requirements and emphasising the specific requirements.

  Ascertain and collate all cost data related to freighter and charter operations ensuring that accurate data is captured in the NGSC system.

  Determine the accurate computation of all cost data related to freighter/charter operations within the system and identify and correct any anomalies.

  Provide information on the profitability of all ad-hoc freighter operations, charter operations and diversions ensuring that information related to such operations are communicated to all relevant internal departments.

  **Prepare analysis and reporting on charter performance, operational efficiency and profitability to support management decision-making.**

  Independently handle special projects as directed by Manager Freighter Operations & Charters, Manager Freighter Analysis & Development or Cargo Scheduling & Planning Manager.

  The job holder will also be required to undertake special projects related to special ground handling requirements and operational procedures related to new aircraft especially the Boeing 777F and Boeing 747-8F **as well as support special cargo projects, humanitarian charters and strategic charter initiatives.**

##### **Qualification**

**Qualifications & Experience:** Should have good knowledge of IATA regulations, rules and procedures.

Should have completed approved Cargo Acceptance and Handling courses including Special Cargo Handling and Acceptance, Cargo Product Knowledge, Advanced Load Control and Freighter Load Control.

Excellent communication & IT skills.

Should have sound analytical skills.

Title: Senior Systems Engineer - Enterprise Services
Description:
The Senior Systems Engineer – Enterprise Services is responsible for the administration, implementation, maintenance, and optimization of enterprise IT infrastructure and Microsoft-based technology solutions across ZainTECH's customer environments. The role ensures the availability, performance, security, and reliability of critical infrastructure services while providing advanced technical support and maintaining operational standards in accordance with customer requirements and industry best practices.

Working closely with customers, technical delivery teams, Project Managers, and other infrastructure specialists, the Senior Systems Engineer supports the full lifecycle of enterprise infrastructure solutions, including deployment, configuration, migration, troubleshooting, and ongoing maintenance. The role also contributes to infrastructure improvements, technical documentation, and knowledge transfer to ensure effective service delivery and long-term operational stability.

Responsibilities:

Enterprise Infrastructure Administration & Operations

* Administer, maintain, and support enterprise IT infrastructure and Microsoft-based systems across customer environments.
* Perform daily, weekly, and monthly operational activities to ensure the availability, performance, and reliability of critical infrastructure services.
* Monitor system health, capacity, and performance, proactively identifying and addressing potential operational issues.
* Implement and maintain system configurations, security controls, and operational procedures in accordance with established best practices.
* Support the administration of enterprise infrastructure services, ensuring secure and reliable access for authorized users.
* Perform preventive maintenance, system updates, and routine operational checks to minimize service disruptions.

Technical Support & Troubleshooting

* Provide advanced technical support to enterprise customers through on-site and remote troubleshooting.
* Investigate, diagnose, and resolve infrastructure incidents, system failures, and performance-related issues.
* Support major customer accounts through proactive technical engagement, issue resolution, and ongoing service improvement.
* Troubleshoot Microsoft infrastructure technologies, including Active Directory, Exchange Server, Microsoft 365, virtualization, and cloud services.
* Escalate complex technical issues to relevant specialists or vendors where required, ensuring appropriate follow-up and resolution.
* Provide technical guidance and knowledge transfer to customer IT teams to support effective system administration and operational continuity.

Infrastructure Implementation & Migration

* Install, configure, deploy, and integrate enterprise infrastructure solutions in accordance with approved technical designs and customer requirements.
* Implement Microsoft infrastructure technologies, including identity services, messaging platforms, virtualization, and cloud-based solutions.
* Support and supervise infrastructure migrations, upgrades, and system modernization activities while minimizing disruption to customer operations.
* Configure and optimize infrastructure environments to meet performance, availability, and security requirements.
* Coordinate implementation activities with Project Managers, technical teams, and customer stakeholders to ensure successful delivery.
* Validate infrastructure configurations and ensure deployed solutions meet agreed technical specifications and operational requirements.

Microsoft Cloud & Enterprise Services

* Administer and support Microsoft Active Directory Domain Services, identity management, authentication, and access control solutions.
* Support Microsoft Exchange Server and Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, OneDrive, and associated collaboration technologies.
* Configure and maintain Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization environments and related infrastructure services.
* Support Microsoft Entra ID (Azure Active Directory), Azure AD Connect, Active Directory Federation Services (ADFS), and Privileged Identity Management (PIM).
* Administer Microsoft Azure infrastructure services, including virtual machines, virtual networks, storage accounts, and related cloud resources.
* Support Microsoft Intune, information protection, and enterprise mobility and security capabilities.
* Implement and maintain monitoring, backup, and disaster recovery solutions using Microsoft Azure and associated technologies.

Testing, Documentation & Reporting

* Perform system integration testing, configuration validation, and operational readiness assessments for implemented solutions.
* Prepare and maintain technical documentation, including system configurations, implementation records, operational procedures, and troubleshooting guides.
* Document infrastructure changes, upgrades, and maintenance activities to ensure accurate technical records.
* Provide regular technical status updates and progress reports to Project Managers, supervisors, and relevant stakeholders.
* Communicate incidents, technical risks, and operational issues clearly, escalating matters requiring management attention.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives to enhance infrastructure performance, security, and service delivery quality.

*Our Culture & Code of Conduct:*

*At ZainTECH, we take pride in a culture built on collaboration, innovation, and uncompromising integrity. We are looking for individuals who share these values and are committed to customer-centricity and ethical excellence. All employees are expected to uphold our Code of Conduct, which serves as a guiding framework for responsible behavior across everything we do — from ho we work with each other to how we engage with clients and partners globally.*

 **Requirements**

**Experience & Qualifications**

* 4–6 years of experience in Microsoft infrastructure administration, enterprise systems engineering, or related IT infrastructure roles.
* Hands-on experience administering and supporting Microsoft Active Directory Domain Services, including user management, authentication, and directory services.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Exchange Server and Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, OneDrive, and related collaboration platforms.
* Experience with Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization technologies.
* Working knowledge of Active Directory Federation Services (ADFS) and hybrid identity environments.
* Experience configuring and supporting Microsoft SQL Server infrastructure.
* Familiarity with Microsoft System Center products and enterprise infrastructure management technologies.
* Hands-on knowledge of Microsoft Azure services, including:
* + Azure Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS): Virtual Machines, Virtual Networks, Storage Accounts, and related infrastructure services.
  + Identity & Access Management: Microsoft Entra ID, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), and Azure AD Connect.
  + Enterprise Mobility & Security: Microsoft Intune, Azure Rights Management, and associated security capabilities.
  + Monitoring & Operations: Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and related infrastructure monitoring services.
  + Backup & Disaster Recovery: Azure Site Recovery and Azure Backup.
* Experience supporting infrastructure implementation, system upgrades, migrations, and technical troubleshooting.
* Good understanding of enterprise infrastructure security, system availability, performance optimization, and operational best practices.
* Strong technical documentation and reporting skills.
* Good written and verbal communication skills in both English and Arabic.
* Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.

Title: Customer Delivery Software Architect
Description:
**About The Role**
Cisco Customer Experience (CX) is seeking a Customer Delivery Software Architect to lead the design and delivery of automation and AI-enabled solutions for a major service provider in Saudi Arabia.
  
  
You will define scalable software architectures that connect network infrastructure, operational systems, data platforms, and business workflows. Working with customer stakeholders and cross-functional Cisco teams, you will translate complex operational needs into secure, reusable, and maintainable solutions.
  
  
This is a software architecture role—not a network migration or product implementation role. Its primary focus is establishing sound architecture, engineering practices, integration patterns, and governance for network automation and intelligent operations.
  
  
Frequent onsite collaboration in Riyadh is required due to customer access controls, local testing requirements, and the need to work closely with engineering and operations teams.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own the end-to-end software architecture for network automation, orchestration, assurance, observability, and AI-enabled operational solutions.
* Translate business and operational requirements into architecture blueprints, technical roadmaps, integration patterns, data models, APIs, and engineering backlogs.
* Design secure, modular, scalable solutions integrating network platforms with systems such as Cisco Crosswork.
* Establish engineering standards covering source control, automated testing, CI/CD, observability, documentation, release management, security, and software lifecycle governance.
* Guide engineering teams through solution design and delivery, conducting architecture reviews and ensuring implementations meet functional and non-functional requirements.
* Leads and influences global, cross-functional teams—including PMs, PgMs, SDMs, CEs, TLs, and customer stakeholders—to ensure successful delivery of complex, multi-architecture solutions aligned to business outcomes
* Define practical approaches for applying AI and analytics to use cases such as anomaly detection, operational insight, decision support, and workflow automation.
* Build reusable frameworks, reference architectures, and best practices while mentoring engineers and strengthening software architecture capabilities across delivery teams.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree with 12 or more years of relevant experience; master’s degree with 8 or more years; PhD with 5 or more years; or equivalent relevant work experience.
* Extensive experience designing and delivering enterprise-grade software, automation, orchestration, or systems-integration solutions.
* Strong proficiency in software architecture principles, distributed systems, API design, event-driven architectures, data modelling, and integration patterns.
* Hands-on experience with Python or a comparable programming language, APIs, Git, automated testing, CI/CD, containers, and modern development practices.
* Experience architecting solutions that integrate network infrastructure, operational platforms, telemetry, data, and business workflows.
* Understanding of AI/ML concepts and their practical application to automation, analytics, and operational use cases.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional engineering teams and communicate effectively with tech.hnical and executive stakeholders.
* Experience with Cisco NSO or comparable orchestration platforms, including service modelling, lifecycle management, device integration and reusable automation components.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in telecommunications, service-provider, or other large-scale, mission-critical environments.
* Knowledge of network orchestration, assurance, observability, and automation platforms, including Cisco Crosswork.
* Experience establishing engineering governance and reusable automation frameworks across multiple teams.
* Familiarity with cloud-native architectures, microservices, Kubernetes, streaming technologies, data platforms, and AIOps.
* Understanding of responsible AI, data governance, model lifecycle management, and security-by-design.
* Experience mentoring software engineers and helping organizations adopt modern software-engineering practices.
* Nature of work: Onsite Full time
* Hours of work: 48 hours per week
* Benefits: Healthcare and Insurance, Employee Stock Purchase program, Flexible Spending Benefit, Flex and Schooling Allowances and many more.
* Application start and end date: 27th October for 4-5 weeks

**Why This Role Matters**
This role will shape the software foundations for scalable network automation and intelligent operations. The successful candidate will combine architecture leadership with practical engineering expertise, helping transform automation into secure, reusable capabilities that deliver sustained operational value.
  
  
Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

 **Job Description**

The GCP Operations Architect is a resident member of a cloud managed-services team, responsible for the day-to-day operation, support and maintenance of a Google Cloud Platform (GCP) environment, with limited support for integrated on-premises infrastructure and hybrid connectivity. He works alongside the Cloud Engineers to keep the platform stable, secure and available, and to align operations with architectural standards and best practices.

**Key responsibilities:**

* Own the platform's operational architecture: resource hierarchy, org policies, Shared VPC and IAM model.
* Act as design authority for changes and new workload onboarding, producing HLD/LLD designs.
* Deploy, provision and maintain GCP infrastructure and manage project and resource lifecycle.
* Resolve incidents within SLAs, lead RCA for major incidents and drive architectural corrective actions.
* Manage VPCs, routing, firewalls, VPN/Interconnect, DNS, load balancers and hybrid connectivity.
* Design HA, backup and disaster recovery strategies, and run restore tests and DR drills.
* Oversee OS patching (Linux/Windows), routine maintenance, health checks and capacity planning.
* Maintain Terraform modules and Cloud Build CI/CD pipelines, and automate recurring operational tasks.
* Manage IAM, firewall policies and Cloud KMS keys; support security, compliance and audit requirements.
* Maintain monitoring, alerting and logging, and deliver operational and FinOps reports
* Mentor Cloud Engineers, maintain runbooks and documentation, and transfer knowledge to customer teams.

**Required Skills & Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
* 4+ years of hands-on public cloud experience (GCP preferred) operating production environments.
* Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect certification (mandatory).
* Strong experience with GCP Compute Engine, VPC, IAM, Cloud Storage, Cloud Monitoring and Logging.
* Experience designing and governing GCP landing zones (resource hierarchy, org policies, Shared VPC).
* Strong cloud networking: VPC design, VPN/Interconnect, DNS, firewalls and load balancing.
* Hands-on experience with Terraform and CI/CD pipelines (Cloud Build or similar).
* Proven ITIL-based incident, problem and change management experience, including RCA.
* Linux and Windows administration, patching, and backup and restore experience.
* Fluent Arabic and English, with strong communication and documentation skills (HLD/LLD, runbooks).

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Google Professional Cloud Network Engineer or Professional Cloud Security Engineer certification
* ITIL 4 Foundation certification.
* Experience working in a resident or managed-services model with defined SLAs.
* Experience designing HA/DR architectures and running DR drills on Google Cloud.
* Knowledge of cloud cost management and optimization strategies, including FinOps principles (budgets, CUDs, rightsizing, labeling).
* Experience with Cloud KMS, Secret Manager and cloud security posture tools.
* Scripting skills in Python, Bash or PowerShell.
* Experience with hybrid environments and core infrastructure services (e.g. AD, DNS, DHCP).
* Knowledge of local and international compliance and regulatory frameworks (NCA, ISO 27001).
* Experience with observability and monitoring platforms.

**Language Requirements**

* Arabic Speakers.
* English.

* Employment Type: Full-time.

Title: Network Engineer
Description:
We are seeking an experienced **Network Engineer** to manage, maintain, and operate the Ministry's network infrastructure across its headquarters and governorate branches.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience in enterprise networking, Cisco infrastructure, routing and switching, wireless LAN configuration, firewall administration, network monitoring, and information security.

The successful candidate will ensure network availability, performance, security, and operational continuity while supporting infrastructure improvements and technical operations.

Key Responsibilities

**Network Infrastructure & Administration**

* Manage daily network operations and technical activities related to IT infrastructure.
* Install, configure, operate, and maintain network switches, Cisco Wireless Controllers, and Cisco Voice Gateways.
* Configure and manage VLANs and perform necessary switch modifications.
* Manage Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking protocols, routing, and switching.
* Monitor network connectivity, internet links, leased lines, and overall network performance.

Description:
**Job Description**

This role is categorized as hybrid. This means the successful candidate is expected to report to the Markham Elevation Centre or the Oshawa Elevation Centre at least three times per week.

  

**The Team & Opportunity**
--------------------------

  

The Enterprise Data team is responsible for supporting and modernizing the data platforms that enable analytics, artificial intelligence, customer engagement, strategic planning, and other enterprise capabilities across GM.

We are building a new team to support the existing legacy environment while migrating and transforming the architecture to a cloud-based platform. This role will help establish the engineering standards, reusable platform capabilities, delivery automation, and operational practices required for a secure, scalable, governed, and reliable cloud data ecosystem.

The ideal candidate combines strong business analysis and stakeholder engagement skills with experience in enterprise data environments and complex technology change. They are comfortable working across business stakeholders, data engineering, software, governance, and data quality teams to clarify needs, manage requirements and delivery processes, and help lead large-scale migration work while supporting the continuity of existing data services.

**The Role**

  

As a Business Analyst, Enterprise Data & Cloud Migration, you will serve as a primary interface between stakeholders across GM Canada and the internal data, software, governance, and data quality teams. You will translate business needs into clear requirements, delivery priorities, processes, and documentation that enable teams to maintain the existing enterprise data environment and deliver its migration to a cloud-based implementation.

This role combines business analysis, delivery coordination, and change management responsibilities. You will manage requirements and documentation, support process definition and improvement, facilitate sprint planning and backlog activities, and coordinate stakeholders through complex, interdependent work. You will play a critical role in migration planning and execution, helping teams assess impacts, manage dependencies and risks, validate outcomes, and maintain business continuity. The cloud implementation may be Azure/Databricks, Google Cloud Platform, or another direction based on platform and business requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Act as the primary point of contact and day-to-day interface between GM Canada stakeholders and internal data, software, governance, and data quality teams.
* Elicit, analyze, document, and validate business, functional, data, reporting, and operational requirements.
* Translate stakeholder needs into clear epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and delivery priorities.
* Coordinate discovery of the existing enterprise data environment, including business processes, data flows, interfaces, dependencies, consumers, controls, and operational procedures.
* Support the ongoing operation of the legacy enterprise data environment while coordinating enhancements, issue resolution, and stakeholder communications.
* Help lead large-scale, complex migration efforts by coordinating business and technical workstreams, requirements, dependencies, risks, decisions, testing, and readiness activities.
* Work with technical teams to assess the business and operational impacts of migrating data, processes, interfaces, reports, and downstream consumers to a cloud-based environment.
* Facilitate requirements traceability from business needs through design, development, testing, release, and post-implementation validation.
* Coordinate data validation, reconciliation, business acceptance, and sign-off activities to confirm migrated data and capabilities meet business needs.
* Create, maintain, and manage project and operational documentation, including requirements, process maps, decision logs, data definitions, meeting outcomes, test scenarios, release materials, and user guidance.
* Define and improve processes, workflows, roles, and handoffs across business and technical teams, including processes for data quality, governance, issue management, and change delivery.
* Facilitate sprint planning, backlog refinement, estimation, prioritization, demos, and retrospectives in partnership with product owners and delivery teams.
* Track progress, milestones, actions, decisions, risks, assumptions, issues, and dependencies; communicate status and escalate blockers to the appropriate stakeholders.
* Support data governance and data quality practices by coordinating ownership, definitions, standards, controls, issue resolution, and business approvals.
* Coordinate stakeholder engagement and change readiness, ensuring affected teams understand upcoming changes, impacts, timelines, and required actions.
* Collaborate with data architects, engineers, developers, analytics teams, product owners, and business partners to ensure proposed solutions align with business outcomes and enterprise standards.
Contribute to continuous improvement of delivery practices, documentation standards, stakeholder communications, and operational processes.  

**Required Qualifications and Skills**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Demonstrated experience as a Business Analyst, Product Analyst, Project Analyst, or in a similar role supporting data, software, technology, or enterprise transformation initiatives.
* Experience eliciting, analyzing, documenting, and validating requirements across multiple stakeholder groups.
* Experience working with data platforms, data warehouses, databases, reporting, data integration, or related enterprise technology.
* Experience supporting complex technology change, migration, modernization, or transformation initiatives, including coordination across multiple teams and dependencies.
* Strong documentation skills, including requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, meeting outcomes, decisions, and status reporting.
* Experience supporting Agile delivery, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, prioritization, estimation, and delivery tracking.
* Ability to understand and communicate data flows, interfaces, system dependencies, business processes, and impacts across upstream and downstream teams.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to identify gaps, clarify ambiguity, assess impacts, and organize complex information.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt communication for business and technical audiences.
* Strong facilitation, relationship-building, and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to align teams with differing priorities.
* Proficiency with collaboration and delivery tools such as Jira and Confluence, or comparable tools.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams, timelines, and priorities.  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Experience supporting enterprise data warehouse or data platform migrations, particularly from on-premises Oracle environments to cloud platforms.
* Familiarity with Azure Databricks, Google Cloud Platform, or comparable cloud data and analytics platforms.
* Experience supporting large-scale or complex migrations involving data, ETL/ELT processes, reports, interfaces, or downstream consumers.
* Experience with data governance, data quality management, metadata, data cataloging, lineage, or master/reference data practices.
* Experience defining migration approach, scope, business impacts, dependencies, readiness criteria, and validation or reconciliation plans.
* Familiarity with SQL and the ability to review queries, data structures, mappings, and reconciliation results.
* Experience coordinating user acceptance testing, defect triage, business sign-off, and post-release validation.
* Experience working in a large, matrixed, or regulated organization with formal security, privacy, risk, or change-management practices.
Familiarity with tools such as Lucidchart, Microsoft Project, Azure DevOps, or equivalent requirements and process-mapping tools.

Title: Global Security Operations Centre Operator
Description:
**About the role**
------------------

**International SOS is currently looking to hire a Global Security Operations Centre Operator in Doha, Qatar.**

An Operator is an integral member of the Global Security Operations Centre (GSOC). Under the direction and guidance of the GSOC Manager and GSOC Supervisor, the GSOC Operator will be tasked with the delivery of high-quality security risk monitoring, advice and the coordination of security assistance services on a profile and itinerary-specific basis to travellers, international assignees, domestic nationals, and QatarEnergy risk managers.

The GSOC Operator will contribute to operational readiness by carrying out tasking to maintain and develop the security provider network and internal Concepts of Operations.

The GSOC Operator is responsible for providing the delivery of professional and effective security assistance services to QatarEnergy to the highest standards of excellence and will also be tasked with intelligence collection, processing, and analysis to provide timely security assessments and advice to QatarEnergy’s Security Team and internal stakeholders, through primarily, but not exclusively, written reports, as required.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Core Support to QatarEnergy**

  

* Deliver high-quality, bespoke, verbal and written security risk assessments tailored to a QatarEnergy Business and Operations profile and itinerary, escalating to the GSOC Supervisor as required.
* Under the guidance of the GSOC Supervisor, coordinate and oversee responses to security requests for assistance, including the production of Plans of Action (POA) for specific Requests for Assistance (RFAs), as required.
* Set up, coordinate and monitor tracking tasks using GPS and communication with clients travelling in complex working environments.
* Contribute to operational readiness by supporting the maintenance and development of the security provider network and internal Concepts of Operations.
* Deliver professional and effective security assistance services to QatarEnergy, ensuring the highest standards of quality and service.

### 

### **Global Threat Monitoring**

  

* Conduct continuous monitoring of global security environments and risk indicators.
* Track geopolitical developments, terrorism, civil unrest, natural hazards and other emerging threats.
* Collect, process and analyse intelligence to support timely security assessments and reporting.
* Escalate identified threats in accordance with established SOPs and guidance from supervisors.

### 

### **Travel Security Risk Management**

  

* Provide support to pre-travel security requirements, including responding to traveller queries and delivering itinerary-specific advice.
* Monitor live travel movements of personnel and maintain situational awareness.
* Coordinate with approved security and medical assistance providers to facilitate support.
* Track and document incidents involving travellers, ensuring accurate reporting and timely updates.

### 

### **Crisis & Emergency Management Support**

  

* Support GSOC monitoring activities during incidents, crises and emergencies.
* Log, update and maintain accurate incident records and case documentation.
* Assist in information dissemination to relevant stakeholders as directed.
* Ensure proper case handover between shifts, maintaining continuity of operations.

* Strong knowledge of the political and security landscape within QatarEnergy’s Region of Operations.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex situations to non-expert audiences in English.
* Ability to critically analyse multiple streams of information under time pressure.
* Demonstrated experience in the application of risk assessments.
* Strong IT skills, including Microsoft Office Suite and other applications.

**Required Work Experience**
----------------------------

* Typically, 1 to 3 years of experience in security intelligence or related fields such as military, government, NGO, journalism; relevant academic studies.
* Independent travel experience to multiple countries, including more challenging risk environments.

  ###
* ### **Preferred Experience**

  + Risk and Crisis Management experience.
  + Experience in writing to senior management and decision-makers.
  + International work experience, including in more challenging risk environments.
  + Experience of working in a customer/client-focused role.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Educated to a degree level (or relevant professional training) in a field related to security, risk management, international politics or international relations.
* Master’s degree in similar fields an advantage.

**Required Languages**
----------------------

* Excellent spoken and written English language.
* Other language (Arabic, French, etc.) proficiency desirable.

The Senior Director is a key member of the Parks and Recreation senior leadership team and shares accountability, alongside the General Manager and fellow Senior Directors, for the overall leadership, performance and strategic direction of the division. Operating within a highly collaborative executive environment, the leadership team works collectively to establish priorities, guide decision-making, allocate resources and advance Council-approved objectives. While accountable for their assigned portfolio and serving as the section's lead representative for related Council, committee, media and stakeholder matters, Senior Directors are expected to adopt an enterprise-wide lens, balancing portfolio needs with the broader interests of the division, the City and the communities it serves. Through this collective leadership model, the team drives integrated solutions, organizational excellence and consistent service delivery across Parks and Recreation.

  

Toronto Parks and Recreation delivers services and spaces that enhance the quality of life for millions of residents. Through recreation programs, aquatics, camps, community centres and multi-use facilities, the division provides opportunities for residents across Toronto's diverse neighbourhoods to stay active, connected and engaged.

  

The City of Toronto is seeking a strategic and accomplished leader to serve as Senior Director, Community Recreation.

  

Reporting to the General Manager, Parks and Recreation, the Senior Director provides executive leadership for one of the largest and most diverse community recreation portfolios in Canada. Responsible for recreation programming, facility operations, service access and capacity, operational performance, workforce strategy and quality assurance, this role ensures recreation services remain accessible, equitable and responsive to community needs.

  

Leading through a team of Directors and multidisciplinary professionals, you will oversee the planning, delivery and continuous improvement of recreation programs and services across Toronto. You will ensure programming, facility operations, workforce resources and service delivery standards operate as an integrated system capable of meeting changing community needs and expectations.

  

This role oversees one of the City's most visible public service portfolios, touching the lives of residents every day through recreation programs, camps, aquatic services, community centres and specialized recreation initiatives. Success requires a leader who can balance operational excellence with community impact, ensuring services are delivered efficiently while advancing equity, inclusion, accessibility and participation across Toronto's diverse neighbourhoods.

  

A central focus of the role is fostering a culture of service excellence. Through strong leadership of workforce planning, employee engagement, talent development, performance management and continuous improvement, you will empower teams to deliver exceptional resident experiences and meaningful community outcomes.

  

Success in this role requires exceptional political acuity, relationship management skills and a deep commitment to public service. You will work closely with elected officials, community organizations, residents, user groups and external partners to advance recreation priorities, address emerging issues and help shape the future of recreation services across Toronto.

  

### **What You Bring to the Role:**

* Post-secondary education in Recreation Administration, Public Administration, Community Development or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

* Extensive senior leadership experience overseeing large-scale recreation, community services, public service delivery or related portfolios within a complex organization.

* Significant experience leading multi-site operations, service delivery systems, workforce management and organizational performance initiatives involving large and diverse workforces.

* Demonstrated expertise in front-line service delivery, service programming, operational planning, customer experience, access and capacity management, performance measurement and continuous improvement.

* Experience managing significant operating budgets and aligning resources, investments and service priorities to achieve strategic and operational objectives.

* Proven ability to lead senior managers, specialized professionals and multidisciplinary teams within a large, diverse and unionized environment.

* Demonstrated success operating in politically sensitive and highly visible environments requiring diplomacy, sound judgment and exceptional stakeholder management capabilities.

* Experience developing productive relationships with community organizations, residents, advocacy groups, government partners and other stakeholders to advance community outcomes.

* Experience presenting strategic recommendations, service initiatives and operational matters to senior leadership teams, elected officials, boards, committees and community stakeholders.

* Familiarity with applicable legislation and regulatory frameworks including occupational health and safety, accessibility, employment and human rights legislation.

The Department advances care for conditions that disproportionately affect women and special populations, including through the specialized Dermatology, Menopause and After Cancer Treatment Transition Clinics.

Its Specialized Medicine programs bring together nursing and health discipline professionals as well as clinical and academic administrative staff.
