**About MF Professional Services, Inc.**
----------------------------------------

MF Professional Services, Inc. (“MFPS”) is an employee leasing and professional services organization that provides human resources, payroll, benefits administration, and operational support services to mission-driven organizations.

This position supports MFPS clients, including Mi Familia Vota (“MFV”) and Mi Familia en Acción (“MFA”). Employees of MFPS may perform services on behalf of MFPS clients in support of their operational, programmatic, and organizational goals.

**About Mi Familia Vota and Mi Familia en Acción**
--------------------------------------------------

Mi Familia Vota and Mi Familia en Acción are national, Latino-led civic engagement organizations dedicated to building political power, strengthening civic engagement, and advancing policies that support Latino communities.

MFA, a 501(c)(3) organization, conducts nonpartisan programs focused on citizenship, voter registration, voter education, leadership development, and issues including immigration, education, healthcare, voting rights, workers’ rights, reproductive rights, and the environment.

MFV, a 501(c)(4) organization, builds Latino political power through advocacy, organizing, and mobilization to help ensure that Latino voices shape the policies affecting their health, safety, and prosperity.

Together, MFV and MFA operate one of the largest Latino civic engagement infrastructures in the country, with programs across Arizona, California, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Nevada, North Carolina, Texas, and Washington, D.C.

**Position Summary**
--------------------

The Field Manager supports MFPS and its clients, including Mi Familia Vota and Mi Familia en Acción, by overseeing a team of canvassers conducting voter outreach and civic engagement activities within Latino communities.

Working with the Field Director, this position helps develop and implement voter-outreach strategies involving door-to-door canvassing, phone banking, text messaging, digital outreach, voter registration, voter education, and other approved direct-contact methods.

The Field Manager recruits, trains, schedules, coaches, and supervises field employees; establishes daily and weekly performance goals; monitors data quality and reporting; and ensures compliance with voter-engagement, safety, timekeeping, and organizational requirements.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
-----------------------------------------

The employee will perform the essential duties described below in support of MFPS and its clients, including Mi Familia Vota and Mi Familia en Acción, as assigned by MFPS-authorized management.

### **Field Strategy and Program Implementation**

* Collaborate with the Field Director and other authorized employees to develop and implement voter-outreach strategies.
* Translate campaign goals into field plans, schedules, staffing assignments, target audiences, outreach methods, and performance measures.
* Coordinate door-to-door canvassing, phone banking, text messaging, digital outreach, voter registration, voter education, and other approved field activities.
* Integrate in-person, telephone, text, and digital voter-contact activities.
* Establish daily and weekly voter-contact, recruitment, registration, engagement, and mobilization goals.
* Monitor field implementation and make operational adjustments within delegated authority.
* Identify barriers, staffing needs, resource constraints, and performance gaps and communicate them to the supervisor.
* Ensure field activities appropriately distinguish between and align with the legally permissible work of MFV and MFA.
* Ensure persuasion, electoral, or other partisan activities are conducted only for an organization legally permitted to engage in those activities.
* Promote accurate, respectful, culturally responsive, ethical, and non-misleading community engagement.

### **Field Team Supervision**

* Supervise and support canvassers, canvass leads, and other assigned field employees.
* Establish clear job expectations, work schedules, shift assignments, daily goals, turf, scripts, and reporting requirements.
* Conduct pre-shift briefings, post-shift debriefings, team meetings, individual check-ins, and field observations.
* Monitor attendance, timekeeping, productivity, quality, conduct, safety, and compliance.
* Provide employees with regular feedback, coaching, recognition, retraining, and professional-development support.
* Motivate employees to meet or exceed approved voter-contact, recruitment, registration, and engagement goals while maintaining quality.
* Identify employee development needs and provide appropriate coaching or escalate as needed.
* Address performance, attendance, conduct, scheduling, safety, or workplace concerns in coordination with the supervisor and Human Resources.
* Promote a professional, inclusive, collaborative, culturally responsive, respectful, and accountable team environment.
* Ensure employees accurately record all time worked and receive required meal and rest periods.

### **Recruitment, Onboarding, and Scheduling**

* Assess field staffing needs based on approved campaign goals, timelines, budgets, and anticipated workload.
* Collaborate with Human Resources and authorized hiring managers on recruitment, interview, selection, and onboarding activities.
* Recruit and support the hiring of qualified canvassers and other assigned field employees.
* Develop staff schedules, shift assignments, supervisory coverage, transportation plans, and contingency plans.
* Ensure new employees complete required onboarding, voter-registration, safety, data, technology, timekeeping, and job-specific training.
* Coordinate access to approved systems, equipment, identification, materials, scripts, and field resources.
* Monitor staffing levels, attendance, turnover, and capacity and recommend appropriate changes.
* Avoid making employment, compensation, scheduling, or disciplinary commitments beyond delegated authority.

### **Training and Staff Development**

* Develop and provide training for canvassers and other assigned field employees.
* Train employees on approved scripts, voter outreach, voter registration, voter education, phone banking, text messaging, digital tools, and field procedures.
* Train employees to use electoral databases, canvassing applications, dialers, texting platforms, and other approved systems.
* Provide training concerning data entry, quality control, reporting, field safety, situational awareness, de-escalation, and incident response.
* Develop guides, presentations, scripts, checklists, standard operating procedures, and other training materials.
* Evaluate employee understanding and provide additional coaching or retraining as necessary.
* Communicate the purpose and importance of accurate data, ethical outreach, respectful engagement, and compliance.
* Maintain required training attendance and completion records.

### **Community and Voter Engagement**

* Engage community members directly in English and Spanish through approved voter-contact and civic engagement activities.
* Provide accurate, non-misleading, and approved information regarding voter registration, voter education, elections, and civic participation.
* Use only authorized scripts, materials, forms, tools, and calls to action.
* Model effective, culturally responsive, and respectful outreach practices for field employees.
* Respond to routine community questions and refer legal, policy, media, complaint, or other complex matters to the appropriate supervisor.
* Respect individuals who decline participation or ask that outreach end.
* Protect voter and community-member privacy.
* Represent MFPS and its clients professionally within assigned communities.
* Avoid making promises or organizational commitments beyond delegated authority.

### **Performance Goals and Accountability**

* Set, monitor, and support achievement of approved daily, weekly, and campaign-level field goals.
* Track direct voter contacts, doors knocked, successful conversations, phone calls, text messages, registrations, commitments, and other assigned metrics.
* Develop and maintain a goal-oriented accountability structure for assigned field teams.
* Review individual and team performance and identify trends, gaps, and coaching needs.
* Use performance information to adjust assignments, training, schedules, or field support.
* Communicate progress, concerns, and recommendations to the supervisor.
* Ensure performance expectations do not encourage inaccurate reporting, rushed work, coercion, misrepresentation, or noncompliance.
* Recognize employees for quality, improvement, teamwork, and achieving approved goals.

### **Data Management and Quality Control**

* Design, document, implement, and improve field data-management practices across approved platforms.
* Ensure consistent data collection for door-to-door, phone, text, digital, voter-registration, and other voter-contact activities.
* Collaborate with data employees to establish data definitions, coding, reporting, quality-control, and submission procedures.
* Monitor use of VAN, MiniVAN, EveryAction, dialers, texting platforms, spreadsheets, and other approved systems.
* Review field data and reports for accuracy, completeness, consistency, reliability, and timely entry.
* Identify missing, duplicate, inconsistent, unsupported, or potentially inaccurate information and coordinate correction.
* Train employees to enter and maintain field data correctly.
* Promptly report suspected data falsification, manipulation, loss, unauthorized access, or other serious concerns.
* Protect confidential voter, community, employee, and organizational information.
* Use data only for authorized organizational purposes.

### **Reporting and Communication**

* Follow all required reporting procedures and submit complete and timely daily, weekly, and campaign reports.
* Prepare field updates concerning staffing, schedules, performance, voter contacts, data quality, incidents, resource needs, and emerging concerns.
* Maintain clear and regular communication with the Civic Engagement Coordinator, State Director, data employees, and other authorized leaders.
* Conduct routine team meetings and communicate organizational and campaign updates.
* Maintain accurate records of staffing, assignments, turf, training, field activity, performance, coaching, incidents, and follow-up actions.
* Organize and prioritize critical information to support efficient decision-making.
* Promptly escalate significant operational, staffing, safety, compliance, data, or reputational concerns.
* Participate in state and national planning meetings, trainings, and campaign activities as requested.

### **Voter-Registration Compliance**

* Follow all applicable laws, regulations, deadlines, and organizational procedures governing voter registration and voter engagement.
* Ensure employees complete required training before collecting or handling voter-registration applications.
* Monitor required form custody, tracking, storage, review, and submission procedures.
* Ensure voter-registration applications are never altered, discarded, withheld, falsified, prefilled without authorization, or used for an unauthorized purpose.
* Immediately report suspected misconduct, falsification, form mishandling, coercion, misrepresentation, or other compliance concerns.
* Cooperate with quality-control reviews, audits, investigations, and corrective-action processes.
* Obtain and maintain any registration, designation, appointment, certification, or training required to supervise voter-registration activities in the assigned jurisdiction.

### **Health, Safety, and Incident Response**

* Implement and enforce applicable workplace and field health, safety, security, and operational protocols.
* Train employees on heat and weather precautions, situational awareness, check-in procedures, de-escalation, transportation safety, and incident reporting.
* Monitor weather, traffic, neighborhood, animal, environmental, and other conditions that may affect field safety.
* Maintain regular communication with employees during field activities.
* Respond promptly to missed check-ins, injuries, threats, harassment, confrontations, vehicle incidents, law-enforcement interactions, or other emergencies.
* Stop or modify field activities and contact appropriate leadership when conditions present a potential safety risk.
* Document and report incidents according to established procedures.
* Avoid making legal, media, medical, law-enforcement, or employment decisions beyond delegated authority.
* Cooperate with post-incident reviews and corrective or preventive measures.

### **Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Collaborate with state leadership and campaigns, programs, data, communications, digital, operations, and Human Resources employees.
* Coordinate staffing, technology, materials, data, training, messaging, and other resources required for field implementation.
* Maintain professional and constructive relationships with community partners and other stakeholders.
* Support rapid-response activities, voter-registration deadlines, election-cycle operations, and special projects.
* Travel to field sites, organizational locations, partner sites, and community events as required.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**
------------------

### **Education**

### **Experience**

* 2–3 years OR 2+ major cycles in civic engagement/campaign leadership.
* 1-2 years managing multi-tiered teams and senior staff.

##### **POSITION SUMMARY**

The Bridge Center (Bridge) at the Public Health Institute (PHI) works across the health care system to expand access to low-barrier addiction treatment and sexual and reproductive health care, and to advance health equity. Since 2019, CA Bridge has supported more than 290 hospitals to implement medications for addiction treatment (MAT) in the emergency department (ED) based on the CA Bridge model for 24/7 low-barrier access to evidence-based care. Since then, Bridge has trained teams in 22 states, 56 EDs, and 6 EMS agencies. Collectively, they reach 2,181 providers whose EDs see nearly 2.5 million patient visits a year.

EMS Bridge extends low-barrier MAT to paramedics, bringing EMS-initiated buprenorphine to communities across the country, including in California. The National Expansion Project builds capacity for emergency department-based MAT across the country; the ED Syphilis/HIV/HCV Screening Program supports emergency departments in implementing routine opt-out screening and linkage to care; and Access Bridge increases access to contraception and treatment for pregnancy emergencies from the ED.

##### **POSITION OVERVIEW**

Bridge is hiring an EMS Education Manager to work with our EMS Bridge team. EMS Bridge began in California, which remains home to our largest EMS program and much of our ongoing EMS research and implementation work, and now supports EMS agencies in other states. The EMS Education Manager will lead day-to-day planning, coordination, and delivery of EMS Bridge education, training, and technical assistance for paramedics, EMTs, and EMS educators, training officers, and agency leaders. Additionally, this role will lead the development and ongoing improvement of EMS Bridge curricula, run EMS Bridge learning collaboratives, and support grant reporting on training and technical assistance activities.
